MOSAIC organizes degraded observations into structural slots that capture complementary object-level and layout-level evidence, integrates them across resolutions, and retrieves recurring priors from a shared prototype memory to complement incomplete image-specific information. The resulting representations are injected into selected layers of a frozen diffusion Transformer through lightweight residual modulation, preserving its pretrained generative prior. We instantiate MOSAIC for remote sensing image super-resolution, where small objects, repetitive structures, and large-scale variation provide a challenging testbed. Experiments on UCMerced, AID, and RSSCN7 show consistent PSNR improvements across $\times 2$ and $\times 4$ settings and favorable LPIPS results at $\times 4$. Qualitative results further demonstrate improved preservation of small objects, structural boundaries, and repetitive spatial patterns.

items.title_en: Efficient Confidence-Aware Densification for 3DGS
items.abstract_en: 3DGS-MCMC has replaced the gradient-driven density control of 3D Gaussian Splatting with opacity-based sampling and relocation, and is now the de facto standard for prior-free densification under a fixed primitive budget. Because opacity stays high where the scene is already well reconstructed, this sampling sends most new primitives to the foreground and leaves the background under-reconstructed. At low budgets, prior-based methods such as ConeGS and EDGS outperform it, at the cost of a pre-trained radiance field or dense image matches and a separate initialization stage. We argue for a comeback of error-driven densification within the fixed-budget MCMC framework. Our confidence-aware densification keeps the fixed budget and gradual growth of 3DGS-MCMC, but places primitives by the image error instead of the opacity. New primitives are drawn mostly where screen-space gradients are large. We favor primitives with a low learned confidence, which marks regions the reconstruction still explains poorly, and relocate the primitives that contribute least to the rendered images to these places. Averaged over 24 scenes, our method outperforms 3DGS-MCMC in PSNR, SSIM and LPIPS at every budget from 100k to 2M primitives. At 100k, without a prior or an initialization stage, it recovers 0.84dB of the 1.05dB PSNR by which ConeGS leads 3DGS-MCMC, and from 500k on, it has the highest PSNR and SSIM of all fixed-budget methods we compare with, including ConeGS and EDGS. While inherently prior-free, our densification can also exploit priors: from the ConeGS or EDGS initialization, it matches ConeGS in PSNR and SSIM at 100k and is best in all three metrics at 500k.

items.title_en: Knowing Whether, Not Just Where: Anchor-Probing Distillation for Open-Set Remote Sensing Visual Grounding
items.abstract_en: Open-set visual grounding in remote sensing requires models to determine not only where a queried object is located, but also whether the image provides sufficient evidence for the query at all. Existing closed-set grounding models, however, tend to return plausible boxes even for absent objects, blurring localization confidence with genuine Visual Support. We introduce AnchorProbe-Distill (APD), a teacher-student framework that recasts open-set grounding as Visual Support learning. APD builds on the insight that supported queries should induce coherent spatial anchors, whereas unsupported or mismatched queries tend to produce unstable or misleading localization patterns. APD-T therefore uses the Original Query as a Reference Anchor to interpret query perturbations: Semantic-Preserving Queries retain the annotated target, Near-Category Ambiguous Queries are resolved according to whether they form a reliable alternative anchor or collapse onto the Reference Anchor, and Far-Category Counterfactual Queries provide rejection supervision. This reference-aware reasoning is distilled into APD-S, enabling unified localization and rejection from a single image--query pair. Experiments show that APD enables the resulting model to reject absent targets while also improving its localization of present targets.

items.title_en: Beyond Successful Robot Demonstrations: Learning from Human Interactions and Modeling Failure Dynamics
items.abstract_en: Action-conditioned world models offer a promising foundation for generalist robotic intelligence by predicting the consequences of actions. However, existing robotic datasets provide limited coverage of the diverse interaction dynamics required for generalizable world modeling. Large-scale egocentric human videos offer complementary interaction experience, yet the embodiment gap between human hands and robotic manipulators hinders effective cross-embodiment learning. Meanwhile, the predominance of successful demonstrations leaves failure dynamics substantially underrepresented, limiting the ability of world models to anticipate unsuccessful executions. To address these limitations, we introduce HF-WM, an action-conditioned world model that combines Human interaction learning with Failure-aware post-training. To bridge the embodiment gap, we develop a dual-branch framework that couples video generation with auxiliary pointflow prediction, using stabilized pointflow as a unified motion representation across human and robot interactions while suppressing egocentric camera motion. To improve failure modeling, we further perform Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) post-training on perturbed actions derived from successful demonstrations, guided by action alignment and physical plausibility rewards, enabling the model to learn plausible failure dynamics without paired ground-truth videos. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HF-WM achieves state-of-the-art performance in action-conditioned video generation and exhibits strong utility for policy evaluation in downstream robotic tasks.

items.title_en: SplatQ: Interaction-Aware Pruning of 3D Gaussian Splatting via Quadratic Selection
items.abstract_en: Existing 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) pruning methods primarily rely on global Top-K selection based on independent importance scores, lacking regional budget control and ignoring joint deletion effects. Consequently, they cannot ensure balanced reconstruction quality across a scene. We propose SplatQ, a combinatorial pruning algorithm that coordinates regional budget allocation and joint Gaussian selection under a fixed budget. SplatQ partitions Gaussians by spatial proximity and appearance similarity into size-limited blocks, decomposing global selection into subproblems of a specific size. It then smooths importance-based block retention quotas to prevent excessive budget concentration. Finally, it constructs a quadratic approximation of joint deletion effects using the responses of representative pixel colors to changes in Gaussian opacity. Individual responses, pairwise interactions, and quota penalties are incorporated into a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) objective, solved using simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM) to jointly select Gaussians. Experiments on 5 benchmarks demonstrate that SplatQ outperforms state-of-the-art pruning methods in aggregate reconstruction quality, spatial quality balance, and rendering speed. Ablations confirm that budget smoothing improves local detail reconstruction, while interaction modeling improves Gaussian selection quality under a fixed budget.

items.title_en: Stride: Scale-Aware Multi-Agent Evolutionary Refinement for Infographic Generation
items.abstract_en: Infographic generation challenges text-to-image models because a single image must satisfy numerous visual, textual, and semantic constraints. Iterative agentic refinement with a multimodal verifier is a natural remedy, but existing methods face a scale mismatch: local edits cannot correct global composition errors, while full regeneration may destroy already-correct regions. We introduce Stride, a constraint-grounded multi-agent framework that treats refinement over any frozen generator as a history-aware evolution strategy. Stride separates constraint evaluation - whether each requirement is satisfied - from visual grounding - where and how it is violated. It then routes global revisions to a composer subagent and local corrections to a retoucher subagent. Each subagent conducts internal planning and generates multiple candidates, while Stride accepts a candidate only when it improves the verifier score, reducing regression across iterations. Because stochastic generators and imperfect verifiers make any single step unreliable, it is this combination of scale-aware routing, per-step redundancy, and monotonic acceptance that yields stable improvement across iterations. With fully open-weight generator-verifier systems, Stride outperforms proprietary systems including Nano-Banana-2.0 and Seedream-5.0-Pro on BizGenEval, matches GPT-Image-2.0 and surpasses Seedream-5.0-Pro on IGenBench, and achieves a new state-of-the-art score on WISE, while substantially outperforming existing agentic methods across all evaluated benchmarks.

items.title_en: A Hybrid and Hierarchical Ray Tracing Method for Efficient 3D Gaussian Rendering
items.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a powerful representation for real-time neural reconstruction and rendering. While existing 3DGS systems rely on rasterization for efficiency, recent work explores ray tracing to enable secondary lighting, highly distorted cameras, and depth-of-field effects. However, compared with rasterization, ray-traced 3DGS introduces three major challenges: (1) the highly non-uniform spatial distribution of massive numbers of Gaussian primitives creates severe load imbalance; (2) neighboring pixels often generate rays with highly similar traversal paths, leading to substantial redundant traversal overhead; and (3) supporting both Gaussian and triangle primitives yields heterogeneous intersection workloads that are not well matched to existing GPU architectures. We present H2-Ray, a hybrid and hierarchical ray tracing architecture for efficient 3D Gaussian rendering. H2-Ray introduces three techniques. Load-Balanced Spatial BVH (LB-SBVH) partitions the scene into uniform grids and uses density-aware representations to convert an imbalanced global workload into balanced local traversal units. Ray-Cluster Path Reuse (RCPR) lets a proxy ray share traversal state with neighboring rays to amortize redundant traversal. The Unified Intersection Engine (UIE) supports mixed Gaussian and triangle intersections through a mode-multiplexed datapath that shares 40% of its floating-point units across both primitive types. Across 8 scenes, H2-Ray achieves a geometric-mean speedup of 3.77x and a maximum speedup of 9.26x over RaySplats on the NVIDIA RTX A5000, combining a cycle-accurate model of the modified RT Core with measured CUDA timings.

items.title_en: Hierarchical Graph Neural Network for Probabilistic Power Flow with Grid Topology Contingencies
items.abstract_en: Data-driven surrogates reduce the nonlinear solves required for probabilistic power flow (PPF), but models tied to a fixed bus--branch graph often generalize poorly when outages change electrical coupling. This paper proposes a topology-decomposition-driven hierarchical bidirectional graph neural network (TDD--HBGNN) for PPF under unseen topologies. For each realized topology, the network is decomposed into fundamental topological units (FTUs), dynamically homogeneous voltage clusters (DHVCs), and a core backbone sub-grid (CBSG), with equivalent-admittance representations preserving electrical ports between units. A sensitivity-based linear prior captures the first-order voltage-magnitude and phase-angle response, while the HBGNN learns topology-dependent nonlinear residuals. Impedance- and uncertainty-aware bottom-up aggregation condenses local perturbations, while mode-modulated top-down broadcasting restores system context at buses. We evaluate our approach on the IEEE 118-bus and Polish 2746-bus systems under unseen N--1 and N--2 contingencies against six baseline methods. Compared with these methods, TDD--HBGNN achieves 2.47--4.20-fold lower all-bus phase-angle errors and lower phase-angle errors in every held-out event. Its voltage-magnitude advantage is concentrated near the outaged branches, where paired error ratios reach 1.75--2.58 on the IEEE system and 1.87--1.97 in Polish N--2 events. All system--contingency--baseline comparisons favor TDD--HBGNN in joint voltage--angle error. Moreover, shared hierarchical operators keep the model size at 0.658 million parameters across both grids and yield 0.161--1.793~ms forward latency per probabilistic case. These results demonstrate system-wide angular accuracy, outage-local voltage accuracy, and parameter-efficient scaling across unseen topologies.

items.title_en: GraftOOD: Grafting Out-of-Distribution Exemplars into Advantage-Weighted Rectification for Video Reward Optimization
items.abstract_en: Video reward optimization can increase proxy rewards while reducing video dynamics, a mismatch we identify as \emph{motion collapse}, including under a video-level motion-quality reward. We propose \textbf{GraftOOD}, which replaces part of the online rollouts in selected prompt groups with out-of-distribution video exemplars. A shared velocity-regression objective combines group-relative reward rectification with sequence-level exemplar supervision, requiring neither exemplar generation trajectories nor an additional supervised-loss coefficient. We characterize its pointwise optimal field as a source-posterior-weighted combination of the two source-specific target fields. We construct \textbf{GraftSet-Video}, containing 9,588 format-matched exemplars for 2,397 prompts, to supply external supervision. On Wan2.1-1.3B, GraftOOD raises Dynamic Degree from 4.86 to 44.41 relative to reward-only FlowAWR, while HPSv3 decreases from 8.10 to 7.32 and VisionReward remains close. At the main setting, GraftOOD leads nine of ten metrics among three exemplar-augmented methods. Ablations of exemplar frequency and within-group count reveal dynamics--reward trade-offs rather than uniform gains from increasing exemplar usage. These results support external exemplar supervision as a complement to scalar reward feedback, without equating higher measured dynamics with coherent, visually plausible motion in the generated videos. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Fuzm7/FlowAWR}{GraftOOD}.

items.title_en: A Real-World CAD Segmentation Benchmark: Comparing Rule-Based and Learning-Based Approaches through Hole Detection
items.abstract_en: CAD segmentation datasets are predominantly synthetic or automatically labelled, leaving it unclear how well existing methods transfer to real-world engineering tasks. Fastener-relevant hole detection represents one such task, requiring human annotation and exhibiting greater geometric complexity than commonly used benchmarks. We address this gap through three main contributions. First, we develop two task-specific rule-based methods, one graph-wire-search and one multi-view based, and complement them with a human-annotated benchmark dataset derived from engineering CAD data that also enables training of UV-Net and AAGNet, representative learning-based approaches for B-Rep segmentation. Second, we conduct an extensive experimental study including parameter optimisation, evaluation on our benchmark dataset, cross-domain generalisation on a synthetic dataset, and an assessment of the feasibility of the approaches at varying dataset sizes and IoU thresholds. Third, we provide evidence-based insights into the strengths and limitations of different approaches: rule-based methods generalise well without training data, with the graph-wire-search method favouring recall and the multi-view method favouring precision, whereas learning-based methods achieve strong performance with sufficient annotations but exhibit reduced robustness under domain shift. These findings highlight trade-offs between data requirements, and robustness, and provide guidance not only for hole detection, but more broadly for real-world CAD segmentation tasks.

items.title_en: When MLLMs miss what humans read: diagnosing and learning to read squint text
items.abstract_en: Multimodal LLMs can fail to read text embedded in an image's coarse structure (text a human recovers by squinting) and report that no text is present. We name this class Squint Text and study it as a recognition deficiency, motivated by cases from a production moderation pipeline. We introduce SquintBench, comprising 1076 production-derived moderation images, and SquintCtrl, a controlled synthetic suite for mechanism diagnosis. Frozen-weight analysis shows that hidden text leaves a coarse signal while glyph identity is weakly represented; identity becomes substantially more accessible when the correct spatial regions are supplied, implicating spatial selection as a major bottleneck. Suppressing high-frequency content also improves reading at a fixed visual-token budget, while visual token count may also contribute. These findings motivate Squint OPSD: a frozen teacher receives a downscaled view and the ground-truth transcription as privileged context, and its token-level distributions supervise a student along on-policy trajectories. At inference, the student reads the original image alone. Squint OPSD reaches 88.61 ANLS on SquintBench, versus 26.50 for the unadapted backbone, 24.44 for the best general-purpose model on the original view, and 68.60 at best for an off-the-shelf model under a downscaled view. These results substantially narrow the gap between available visual evidence and its generated read-out without auxiliary views at inference.

items.title_en: SADL: A Size-Adaptive Decision Layer for Chronic Stroke Lesion Segmentation in ISLES 2026
items.abstract_en: Chronic ischemic stroke lesions are difficult to segment on T1-weighted MRI. Their appearance overlaps with healthy tissue, and their volumes span four orders of magnitude, so voxel-level and lesion level metrics often disagree. We build an eleven-member nnU-Net ensemble that covers five design axes: a baseline dice + top-K loss, heavy augmentation, per-lesion volume loss re-weighting, stochastic weight averaging, and a sampling-and-architecture block that pairs cohort-balanced sampling with a residual-encoder backbone. Weighted soft-map fusion of the members feeds a tuned decision layer, SADL, that estimates lesion volume, applies an adaptive per-lesion-size threshold, prunes components by voxel count and peak probability, and adds a never-empty rescue. All fusion weights and per-bucket parameters are fitted on out-of-fold (OOF) predictions, so tuning never touches the held-out test set. On a site-disjoint 91-case holdout, SADL reaches Dice 0.7322, lesion-F1 0.7461 and PR-AUC 0.8430 when scored online with the challenge's released evaluation code. A paired non-parametric bootstrap against a reference single ensemble member confirms the lesion-F1 gain at p=0.024, and the gain is largest in the small-lesion regime, where the rescue step recovers cases that a fixed threshold would silently discard.

items.title_en: TextVBench: Evaluating Text Rendering and Preservation in Video Generation
items.abstract_en: Modern video generators can synthesize convincing scenes while rendering a few characters incorrectly, omitting requested text, or changing it across frames. Measuring these failures is harder than applying OCR independently to each frame: when a scene contains multiple text targets and multiple noisy OCR regions, the evaluator must first determine which observation belongs to which intended text. We introduce TextVBench, a benchmark and evaluation framework that formulates visual-text evaluation as a multi-target, multi-instance spatiotemporal correspondence problem. TextVBench contains two complementary tracks: TextVBench-T2V measures the creation and maintenance of prompt-specified text, while TextVBench-Ref2V measures preservation of text from reference images. Both tracks use target-conditioned candidate selection rather than unconstrained VLM transcription, support one target mapping to multiple OCR regions, and separate frame-level spatial fidelity from cross-frame temporal fidelity. A length-weighted harmonic score summarizes these factors, while extra-text diagnostics expose failure modes hidden by a single OCR score. The benchmark is organized around controlled text, layout, carrier, and motion attributes so that aggregate scores can be traced back to specific capability limits. Across the evaluated model runs, MiniMax-H3 reaches a T2V TextVScore of 68.32, while the strongest Ref2V score is 56.51; attribute slices reveal a pronounced drop as the number of simultaneous reference text regions increases.

items.title_en: Radiomics-Based Thyroid Nodule Classification with Label-Conditional Conformal Prediction
items.title_zh: 基于影像组学的甲状腺结节分类结合标签条件共形预测
items.abstract_en: Thyroid nodule malignancy assessment relies on ultrasound imaging, yet current risk stratification systems suffer from substantial interobserver variability, contributing to a high rate of unnecessary biopsies. We propose a radiomics-based framework combining quantitative feature extraction via PyRadiomics with a Generalized Additive Model (GAM) classifier, selected among six candidates for its favorable trade-off between discriminative performance and interpretability. To complement point predictions with uncertainty estimates, Cross-Conformal Prediction with label-conditional guarantees is applied, flagging ambiguous cases for clinical review rather than forcing a binary decision. Experiments are conducted on TN5000, a publicly available ultrasound dataset of thyroid nodules. After Spearman correlation filtering, 36 features are retained and the GAM achieves an AUC of $0.89$, a sensitivity of $0.83$, and a specificity of $0.82$ on the validation set. At a significance level $ε=0.09$, selected to ensure empirical coverage guarantees on both classes, 63\% of nodules on the test set receive a certain (i.e., single-label) prediction, with conditional precision of $0.94$ for certain malignant and conditional Negative Predictive Value (NPV) of $0.73$ for certain benign cases, while the remaining 37\% are referred to the clinician.

items.title_en: ECGWmark: Deep Watermarking for Electrocardiogram Signals
items.title_zh: ECGWmark：面向心电图信号的深度水印
items.abstract_en: Secure transmission of electrocardiogram (ECG) signals remains a major challenge in telecardiology. While traditional mathematical watermarking can embed patient metadata directly into ECG signals, it is highly fragile against temporal desynchronization such as circular phase shifts. In contrast, existing deep watermarking approaches for temporal signals, such as audio, typically rely on lossy quantization, which compromises the high-frequency micro-morphological details critical for clinical diagnosis. To bridge this gap, we propose ECGWmark, a fully convolutional and quantization-free deep watermarking framework for medical time-series. ECGWmark operates in a continuous, full-resolution latent space and utilizes a localized frame-level mechanism to improve the robustness to severe desynchronization. Crucially, we introduce a differentiable Physiological Loss guided by a clinical classifier to preserve diagnostic semantics. Experiments on the benchmark MIT-BIH database show that ECGWmark maintains channel-bit extraction accuracy above 90% under the evaluated circular temporal shifts. Furthermore, under a rigorous inter-patient diagnostic evaluation, Class-V sensitivity changes from 71.97% to 76.50%, whereas Macro-F1 changes from 35.25% to 34.71% and Class-S sensitivity from 8.89% to 1.39%; these results indicate mixed class-level effects.

items.title_en: Sleep-dependent modulation of thalamic brain temperature estimates in humans
items.title_zh: 人类丘脑脑温度估计的睡眠依赖性调制
items.abstract_en: Mammalian thermal physiology is geared towards dissipating heat during sleep. Brain temperature typically decreases during non-rapid-eye-movement (NREM) sleep in all mammalian species measured to date, yet non-invasive confirmation in healthy humans is lacking: the only available human study used invasive recordings in epileptic patients without a wake control condition. Magnetic resonance spectroscopy (MRS) enables brain temperature mapping non-invasively, using the temperature-sensitive chemical shift of water relative to N-Acetyl-Aspartate as an internal reference. First, we validated that with metabolite cycling (MC), a MRS approach that enables the simultaneous acquisition of metabolite and water information without conventional water suppression, can be used to determine estimates of brain temperature in an ex vivo sheep head. Next, we determined that by using a temporal resolution of ~4 minutes, we obtained high-quality spectra without losing excessive temporal resolution. We then re-analyzed an existing set of MRS data (acquired with the MC sequence) of the thalamus in young adults (n=9) who slept in the evening for up to 2 hours in the scanner, to assess sleep-evoked changes in estimates of brain temperature. Of the nine participants, five participants took part in the subsequent wake-only experiment, allowing to control for the potential impact of circadian time and body posture on estimates of brain temperature. Sleep-wake states were quantified with standard polysomnography, confirming that the participants managed to sleep in the scanner. On average, they spent 39.4+/-15.7 min in N2 sleep, 24.8+/-18.1 min in N3 sleep, 10.0+/-4.9 min in N1 sleep, and 37.0+/-19.6 min awake. Estimates of brain temperature were correlated across the sleep and wake-only experiment within the same participant (R^2=0.29, P<0.0001). When participants entered NREM sleep, estimates of brain temperature decreased by 0.2 degrees Celcius. Moreover, the deeper NREM sleep, the more pronounced the decrease in estimates of brain temperature (P=0.014). These data suggest that an evening nap consisting of NREM sleep decreases thalamic temperature. Considering the profound impact temperature can have on brain functioning, these brain temperature changes could be a pathway through which sleep impacts the brain.
items.abstract_zh: 哺乳动物的热生理倾向于在睡眠中散热。迄今测量的所有哺乳动物中，脑温度在非快速眼动（NREM）睡眠期间通常下降，但健康人始终缺乏无创验证：唯一可用的人体研究是对癫痫患者的侵入性记录，且没有清醒对照条件。磁共振波谱（MRS）可利用水相对 N-乙酰天冬氨酸（NAA）的温度敏感化学位移作为内参，无创地绘制脑温度。我们首先在离体羊头上验证：代谢物循环（MC）这一无需常规水抑制、可同时采集代谢物与水信息的 MRS 方法，能用于确定脑温度估计；接着确定约 4 分钟的时间分辨率即可获得高质量谱图，而不会牺牲过多时间分辨率。随后我们重新分析了一组已有的年轻成人丘脑 MRS 数据（n=9）：他们在傍晚于扫描仪中睡眠至多 2 小时，用以评估睡眠诱发的脑温度估计变化。九人中有五人参加了随后的仅清醒实验，以控制昼夜节律时间和身体姿势的潜在影响。睡眠—觉醒状态经标准多导睡眠图量化，确认参与者确实在扫描仪中入睡：平均 N2 睡眠 39.4±15.7 分钟、N3 睡眠 24.8±18.1 分钟、N1 睡眠 10.0±4.9 分钟、清醒 37.0±19.6 分钟。脑温度估计在睡眠与仅清醒实验之间呈相关。
items.highlight_zh: 用 MRS 无创评估人类睡眠中的丘脑脑温度变化
items.digest_zh:
1）研究了什么问题：包括人在内的哺乳动物，睡眠时通常散热、脑温下降，但这一现象在健康人身上一直没有无创证据。唯一的人体研究来自癫痫患者的有创记录，而且缺少清醒状态作为对照，因此无法判断脑温变化究竟是不是睡眠引起的。
2）用了什么方法：磁共振波谱（MRS）可以无创测温，原理是水与 N-乙酰天冬氨酸（NAA）之间的化学位移对温度敏感。作者先在离体的羊头上验证「代谢物循环（MC）」序列——它不需要常规的水抑制就能同时采集代谢物和水信号——可以给出可靠的脑温度估计；随后确定约 4 分钟的时间分辨率足以兼顾谱图质量与时间精度。接着，他们重新分析了一组已有的年轻成人丘脑 MRS 数据（9 人），这些人在傍晚于扫描仪内睡眠最多两小时；其中 5 人还参加了后续的「仅清醒」实验，用来排除昼夜节律时刻与身体姿势的干扰。多导睡眠图确认受试者确实睡着了。
3）有什么结果：睡眠结构为 N2 约 39.4 分钟、N3 约 24.8 分钟、N1 约 10 分钟、清醒约 37 分钟；脑温度估计在睡眠与仅清醒实验之间呈相关。
4）为何重要：这项研究从方法学上验证了 MC-MRS 用于无创脑测温的可行性（先离体验证、再定时间分辨率），并首次在健康人中把睡眠与清醒对照纳入同一分析框架，为今后无创研究人类睡眠中的脑温度调节打下基础。

items.title_en: Dual-Antigen CCHFV Vaccine Induces Neutralizing Immunity and Protection Against Lethal Challenge
items.title_zh: 双抗原CCHFV疫苗诱导中和免疫并抵御致死性攻击
items.abstract_en: Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever virus (CCHFV) is a WHO-priority pathogen with high mortality and wide global distribution. A major challenge in CCHFV vaccine development is identifying antigens that induce functional cellular and humoral immunity. We previously showed that the CCHF nucleoprotein (NP) elicits protective responses in mice and non-human primates but does not induce neutralizing antibodies. We therefore systematically screened six chimeric DNA vaccines expressing different CCHF glycoproteins combined with NP. A construct comprising the ectodomain of the glycoprotein Gc and NP elicited robust antibody and T-cell responses to both antigens. The Gc-NP gene was subsequently developed as a lipid nanoparticle-formulated mRNA vaccine using a scalable manufacturing pipeline. Gc-NP mRNA-LNP induced robust antigen-specific humoral and cellular responses comparable to those elicited by the corresponding DNA vaccine, despite the substantially lower dose. Both vaccine approaches generated Gc-directed neutralizing antibody responses against CCHFV pseudovirus and protected mice against homologous Hoti and heterologous IbAr10200 strain challenge. These findings demonstrate that systematic antigen screening combined with genetic vaccine platforms can identify a potent multi-antigen CCHF vaccine candidate.
items.abstract_zh: 克里米亚-刚果出血热病毒（CCHFV）是世界卫生组织优先关注的病原体，死亡率高、分布广泛。CCHFV疫苗研发的主要难点是找到能同时诱导功能性细胞免疫与体液免疫的抗原。我们此前发现CCHF核蛋白（NP）可在小鼠和非人灵长类中引发保护性应答，却不诱导中和抗体。为此我们系统筛选了六种将不同CCHF糖蛋白与NP组合的嵌合DNA疫苗，其中由糖蛋白Gc胞外域与NP组成的构建体可对两种抗原产生强效的抗体与T细胞应答。随后我们用可规模化生产流程将该Gc-NP基因开发为脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）递送的mRNA疫苗。Gc-NP mRNA-LNP在剂量显著更低的情况下，仍诱导出与对应DNA疫苗相当的抗原特异性体液和细胞应答。两种疫苗均产生针对CCHFV假病毒的Gc定向中和抗体，并保护小鼠抵御同源Hoti株与异源IbAr10200株的攻击。这些结果表明，系统抗原筛选结合基因疫苗平台可鉴定出强效的多抗原CCHF候选疫苗。
items.highlight_zh: 系统抗原筛选与基因疫苗平台锁定多抗原CCHF候选疫苗
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：CCHFV是致死率极高的优先病原体，目前没有获批疫苗。难点在于找不到既能诱导中和抗体、又能激发T细胞免疫的抗原——此前看好的核蛋白（NP）只能提供保护，不产生中和抗体。
- 方法：先把6种不同的CCHF糖蛋白分别与NP组合成嵌合DNA疫苗逐一筛选，挑出最优的Gc胞外域+NP组合；再把它做成脂质纳米颗粒（LNP）包裹的mRNA疫苗，并采用可放大的生产工艺。
- 结果：Gc-NP mRNA在剂量低得多的情况下，仍产生与DNA疫苗相当的抗体和T细胞应答；两种疫苗都诱导出针对CCHFV假病毒的中和抗体，并让小鼠扛住同源Hoti株和异源IbAr10200株的致死攻击。
- 为何重要：它证明“系统筛选抗原＋基因递送平台”这条路线能高效找到多抗原候选疫苗，为CCHFV以及其它出血热疫苗的研发提供了可复制的思路。

items.title_en: Anti-trypanosomal activity and target validation of the M17 leucyl-aminopeptidase inhibitor DDD00057570 in Trypanosoma cruzi
items.title_zh: M17亮氨酰氨肽酶抑制剂DDD00057570抗克氏锥虫活性及靶点验证
items.abstract_en: Background: Chagas disease, caused by the parasite Trypanosoma cruzi, affects six to seven million people, and its treatment still relies on two drugs introduced more than fifty years ago, both of limited efficacy and poorly tolerated. The major acidic M17 leucyl-aminopeptidase of T. cruzi is expressed in all developmental stages of the parasite and has been proposed as a drug target, but it has not been pharmacologically validated. Methodology/Principal Findings: We assessed DDD00057570, a compound originally identified as an inhibitor of the orthologue enzyme of Leishmania major, against the recombinant T. cruzi enzyme and against the parasite. The compound inhibited the recombinant enzyme with an IC50 of 2.7 {+/-} 0.9 {micro}M and reduced the proliferation of insect-stage epimastigotes, with a half-maximal effective concentration of 3.7 {+/-} 1.1 {micro}M. Parasites engineered to overexpress the enzyme were twice as resistant to the compound as wild-type parasites, indicating that the enzyme is a primary target in the living parasite. Treatment increased the proportion of epimastigotes with fragmented DNA. In infected mammalian cells, the compound reduced the release of trypomastigotes, the stage responsible for dissemination in the mammalian host, with a half-maximal effective concentration of 1.3 {+/-} 0.6 {micro}M, while its half-maximal cytotoxic concentration on CHO-K1 mammalian host cells was 41.5 {+/-} 3.9 {micro}M, resulting in a selectivity index of approximately 32. Conclusions/Significance: These results validate the major M17 leucyl-aminopeptidase as a drug target in T. cruzi through target overexpression, and identify DDD00057570 as a selective lead structure warranting mechanistic, pharmacokinetic and in vivo studies toward a new treatment for Chagas disease.
items.abstract_zh: 背景：由克氏锥虫（Trypanosoma cruzi）引起的恰加斯病影响600至700万人，治疗仍依赖五十多年前问世的两种药物，疗效有限且耐受性差。克氏锥虫主要的酸性M17亮氨酰氨肽酶在寄生虫所有发育阶段均有表达，被视为潜在药物靶点，但一直未获药理学验证。方法与主要发现：我们评估了最初作为利什曼原虫同源酶抑制剂发现的化合物DDD00057570，测试其针对重组克氏锥虫酶和寄生虫本身的效果。该化合物抑制重组酶的IC50为2.7±0.9 µM，抑制昆虫期上鞭毛体增殖的半数有效浓度为3.7±1.1 µM。过表达该酶的工程化寄生虫对化合物的抗性为野生型的两倍，表明该酶在活体寄生虫中是主要靶点。药物处理增加了DNA断裂的上鞭毛体比例。在感染的哺乳动物细胞中，该化合物以1.3±0.6 µM的半数有效浓度减少锥鞭毛体（负责在哺乳动物宿主体内播散的阶段）的释放，而其对CHO-K1哺乳动物宿主细胞的半数细胞毒浓度为41.5±3.9 µM，选择性指数约为32。结论与意义：这些结果通过靶点过表达验证了主要M17亮氨酰氨肽酶是克氏锥虫的药物靶点，并确定DDD00057570为值得开展机制、药代动力学和体内研究的先导结构，以推动恰加斯病新疗法开发。
items.highlight_zh: 过表达验证M17为靶点，DDD00057570选择性高
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：恰加斯病由克氏锥虫引起，全球约600–700万人受累，而治疗仍靠50多年前的两种老药，疗效有限、副作用大，迫切需要新靶点和新药。
- 方法：研究对象是克氏锥虫的主要酸性M17亮氨酰氨肽酶，它在寄生虫各发育阶段都表达，长期被怀疑是药靶却未获验证。研究者用已知的利什曼原虫同源酶抑制剂DDD00057570，测试它对重组酶和活寄生虫的作用，并用过表达该酶的虫株做靶点确证。
- 结果：该化合物抑制重组酶IC50约2.7 µM，抑制上鞭毛体增殖的EC50约3.7 µM；过表达虫株耐药性翻倍，说明该酶是活体内的主靶点；处理造成DNA断裂；在感染细胞中使锥鞭毛体释放减少（EC50约1.3 µM），而对哺乳动物细胞毒性较低（CC50约41.5 µM），选择性指数约32。
- 为何重要：这是首次用药理学与遗传学双重手段确认M17酶是可行靶点，并给出一个有选择性的先导化合物，为后续机制、药代与体内研究铺路。

items.title_en: Beyond ERBB2 amplification: RNA and proteomic HER2 assessment for pan-tumor treatment stratification
items.title_zh: 超越ERBB2扩增：RNA和蛋白质组学HER2评估用于泛肿瘤治疗分层
items.abstract_en: HER2-directed therapies are expanding across solid tumors, but ERBB2 amplification incompletely captures HER2 expression and pan-tumor IHC lacks standardization. We developed ERBB2 mRNA, bulk HER2 protein and RNA-signature screening benchmarked against IHC/FISH. Screening identified HER2-enriched populations beyond amplification in a pan-tumor discovery cohort of 1,331 tumor biopsies and validated RNA-based screening in an external cohort of 3,898 tumor biopsies. All six objective responses among 51 treated patients in the discovery cohort occurred in tumors positive by ERBB2 mRNA and the combined RNA-signature. In the external dataset (n=102), ERBB2 mRNA positivity was associated with longer time on treatment (hazard ratio 0.42, 95% confidence interval 0.27-0.64) and overall survival (0.41, 0.25-0.65), with concordant associations for the combined RNA signature. Spatial proteomics comprising 2,721 tiles across 88 samples captured HER2 hetero-geneity and identified HER2-enriched profiles below bulk thresholds. These findings support prospective evaluation of RNA and proteomic screening for treatment selection.

items.title_en: Cross-database adaptation of machine learning models for predicting sustained antibiotic exposure among patients with intracerebral hemorrhage in intensive care units
items.title_zh: 跨数据库适配机器学习模型以预测重症监护室脑出血患者的持续抗生素暴露
items.abstract_en: Background: Patients with intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH) in intensive care units (ICUs) frequently receive antibiotics early in critical illness. Such exposure reflects suspected infection, physiological deterioration, monitoring intensity, and clinical management and may vary across institutions and electronic health record databases. We evaluated target-domain adaptation for modeling sustained antibiotic exposure in critically ill patients with ICH. Methods: We analyzed derived ICH cohorts from MIMIC-IV and the eICU Collaborative Research Database. MIMIC-IV included 2,024 ICU stays and served as the source cohort. The eICU cohort comprised 1,277 stays and was divided, at the ICU-stay level, into a development subset (766 stays) and a held-out evaluation subset (511 stays). The eICU outcome was sustained antibiotic exposure on at least two ICU days. Candidate models incorporated demographic, comorbidity, physiological, laboratory, neurologic, respiratory, temporal, and measurement-process features. Timestamped observations for static and temporal tabular families were censored at the recorded first-antibiotic time when available, whereas the compact sequence component and explicit measurement-density features used the full first 24 hours. For base-model families using eICU development data, meta-learner inputs were generated by five-fold stratified cross-fitting. A 42-input L2-penalized logistic meta-learner combined 16 model probabilities with model-summary, clinical, availability, and measurement-density features. Results: The held-out eICU subset contained 48 positive outcomes (9.39%). The adapted ensemble achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.841 (95% CI 0.775-0.899) and an average precision (AP) of 0.540 (95% CI 0.399-0.676), with a Brier score of 0.063 and expected calibration error of 0.029. The MIMIC-IV source-only stack achieved an AUROC of 0.782; the paired AUROC difference was 0.059 (95% CI 0.003-0.112). In a separate patient-grouped five-fold out-of-fold sensitivity analysis of 503 linked eICU stays, AUROC was 0.807 (95% CI 0.691-0.910). Conclusions: Target-domain adaptation improved held-out discrimination relative to a source-only stack for sustained antibiotic exposure. Because some model components and measurement-process features used information from the broader first 24 hours, the model should be interpreted as a first-24-hour treatment-association model rather than a strictly prospective pre-treatment infection predictor.

items.title_en: Functionality status and drivers of non-functionality of the standardised laboratory analysers in Tanzania mainland: Findings from a National Equipment Harmonisation and Standardisation Mapping Exercise
items.title_zh: 坦桑尼亚大陆标准化实验室分析仪的功能状态及非功能性驱动因素：来自国家设备协调与标准化摸底调查的发现
items.abstract_en: Introduction Reliable, well-maintained laboratory equipment is essential for timely, accurate and reliable laboratory results for patient care, surveillance, and health system resilience. Tanzania implemented the Standard Medical Laboratory Equipment Guideline (SMLEG-2018) to harmonise procurement and improve efficiency across a tiered laboratory system and network. However, equipment functionality gaps remain a critical challenge for healthcare delivery. This study determined the functionality status of standardised laboratory analysers in Tanzania mainland and identified the drivers of non-functionality. Methods We conducted a facility-based cross-sectional study to identify the causes of non-functionality of standardised chemistry, haematology, and urine analysers across mainland Tanzania. We assessed 3,044 analysers and used Pareto analysis to identify the primary drivers of non-functionality. Results Of the 3,044 standardised analysers assessed, 987 (32.4%) chemistry 1,308 (43.0%) haematology, and 749 (24.6%) urine) assessed; 397 (13.0%) were non-functional. Proportionally, urine analysers were the most non-functional (n=176/749, 23.5%), followed by chemistry (n=135/987, 13.7%), and haematology (n=86/1308, 6.6%) analysers, p<0.001. Urine analysers had significantly higher non-functional equipment (23.5%), followed by Chemistry analysers (13.7%), than Haematology analysers (6.6%), p<0.001. Equipment breakdown was the leading cause of non-functionality, accounting for 70.9% (61/86), 70.5% (124/176) and 60.0% (81/135) of the non-functional haematology, urine and chemistry analysers, respectively, among all causes identified for each analyser type. Conclusion Although the SMLEG 2018 implementation identified broad coverage of functional standardised laboratory equipment, persistent equipment breakdowns of more than 10% highlight a systemic, concerning gap that requires immediate corrective action to sustain high performance. Strengthening preventive maintenance, timely repair services and sustainable equipment lifecycle planning is critical to sustaining quality laboratory services for robust preventive and curative care.

items.title_en: Transmission timing and containment risk in human Andes virus outbreaks
items.title_zh: 人安第斯病毒疫情中的传播时间与遏制风险
items.abstract_en: The 2026 multinational Andes virus (ANDV) outbreak linked to cruise-ship travel from Argentina triggered extensive contact tracing and quarantine. Whether intervention on this scale was necessary or sufficient depends on the risk of onward transmission, which can be difficult to estimate early in an outbreak. Using transmission-pair data from the 2018--2019 outbreak in Epuyen, Argentina, and a mechanistic model linking viral growth, symptom onset, and transmission, we estimated that 42.4% (95% CrI: 18.2-69.7\%) of transmission occurs before symptom onset and that the median incubation period is 18.5 days (95% CrI: 16.5-19.5). We simulated outbreaks under an Epuyen-calibrated estimate (R = 2.12, k = 0.316) and a pooled estimate from 15 prior ANDV investigations (R = 0.24, k = 0.39), with intervention beginning after two generations, as in the cruise-associated event. Under the higher-transmission scenario, missing 10% of exposed individuals or downstream contacts resulted in a 29.9% probability of continued spread and a 20.6% probability that at least 5,000 ultimately uninfected people would be quarantined. Under lower transmission, continued spread stayed below 8%. However, the risk of onward transmission could not be estimated precisely from the first several detected cases. These findings therefore support rapid, comprehensive contact tracing and quarantine after large international exposure events despite substantial costs.

items.title_en: Sex Differences in Primary Care Contacts and Recurrent Overdose Risk in British Columbia
items.title_zh: 不列颠哥伦比亚省初级保健接触与复发性用药过量风险的性别差异
items.abstract_en: Background: Risk of recurrent overdose is elevated following non-fatal overdose (NFOD) survival; timely interventions may reduce this risk. The specific role of mental health care in reducing recurrence is relatively underexplored, and post-overdose care has seldom been examined for sex differences. This study examined sex differences in the association between mental health-related primary care contacts following NFOD and overdose recurrence risk among people in British Columbia (BC) with a documented depression diagnosis history. Methods: This was a nested case-control study using linked administrative health data from the Provincial Health Services Authority Platform for Analytics and Data. The source cohort (n=7,022) comprised BC residents with a history of a documented depression diagnosis between 2010-2014 and at least one NFOD between 2015-2024. Cases experienced a recurrent overdose within one year of their index overdose; controls were selected using incidence density sampling. Exposures were the presence and number of mental health related primary care contacts in the 30- or 90-day window following the index overdose. Conditional logistic regression models were used to estimate adjusted incidence rate ratios (aIRRs) and confidence intervals (CI), overall and by sex. Secondary analyses were conducted using psychiatrist contacts. Results: Mental-health related primary care contact rates were low, with only 16.3% and 28.1% of the cohort with any contact within 30 and 90 days, respectively. Mental health-related primary care contacts were more strongly associated with reduced recurrence risk in the 30-day window (any contact aIRR: 0.57 [CI: 0.46-0.71]) than in the 90-day window (aIRR: 0.78 [CI: 0.65-0.94]). Any contact within 30 days was more strongly associated with lower recurrence risk among males (aIRR: 0.53 [CI: 0.39-0.72]) than among females (aIRR: 0.67 [CI: 0.50-0.91]), whereas associations between the number of contacts and recurrence risk were similar for males and females. Any psychiatrist contact within 30 days was more strongly associated with lower recurrence risk among females (aIRR: 0.50 [CI: 0.34-0.73]) than males (aIRR: 0.70 [0.52-0.95]). Discussion: Mental health-related care contacts shortly following NFOD were associated with lower overdose recurrence risk among people with a documented depression diagnosis history, with modest sex differences that varied by provider type. Low rates of contacts overall suggest gaps in access to care following NFOD, particularly among males. Further research on sex differences in post-overdose care are warranted.

items.title_en: Machine Learning-based Prediction of Pacing-Induced Cardiomyopathy in Patients with Atrioventricular Block Underlying Heart Failure with Mildly Reduced or Preserved Ejection Fraction
items.title_zh: 基于机器学习的起搏诱导心肌病预测：在合并射血分数轻度降低或保留的心力衰竭的房室传导阻滞患者中
items.abstract_en: Background: Pacing-induced cardiomyopathy (PICM) is a major complication of chronic right ventricular pacing and develops in up to 25% of patients. Reliable prediction of PICM may facilitate individualized pacing strategy selection; however, currently available approaches demonstrate limited discriminative performance. This study aimed to develop and validate machine learning (ML) models for predicting PICM in patients with atrioventricular block (AVB) underlying heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction. Methods: In this multicenter prospective study derived from the RISK-PICM registry (January 2002 to January 2026), 125 patients with AVB who underwent pacemaker implantation were analyzed. PICM was defined as a ?10% reduction in left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) resulting in an LVEF <50%. Four ML algorithms, including logistic regression, support vector machine, random forest, and XGBoost, were trained using stratified 4-fold cross-validation with hyperparameter optimization and model discrimination was evaluated. Results: PICM developed in 41 patients (32.8%) during a median follow-up of 4.8 years. Male sex, pre-implant minimum QTc interval, and post-implant maximum QRS duration were significantly associated with PICM in univariable Cox regression. XGBoost achieved the highest discriminative performance (AUROC 0.831; sensitivity 0.805; specificity 0.845). Feature importance analysis identified baseline LVEF and post-implant maximum QRS duration as the most influential features. Model-derived risk stratification significantly differentiated high-risk and low-risk groups on Kaplan-Meier analysis (P < 0.001). Conclusions: ML-based models, particularly XGBoost, demonstrated clinically meaningful performance for PICM and may support individualized pacing strategy selection in patients with AVB and underlying heart failure with mildly reduced or preserved ejection fraction.

items.title_en: Performance of the Heatwave ED Forecast Tool in the Emergency Department Network of Ticino Canton, Switzerland
items.title_zh: 热浪急诊科预测工具在瑞士提契诺州急诊科网络中的性能
items.abstract_en: Objectives: Heatwaves drive surges in acute care demand, yet heat-health action plans (HHAPs) lack tools to scale emergency care responses. This study validated a forecasting tool for heatwave-related emergency department (ED) demand across four clusters comprising the emergency care network of Ticino Canton, Switzerland. Methods: This retrospective, ecological, time-series study modeled daily mean temperature and ED presentations using a distributed lag non-linear model framework with autoregressive and calendar adjustment components. The model was trained on summers (June-August) 2016-2024 and tested on summer 2025, defining heatwaves as daily mean temperature >25 {degrees}C for [≥]3 consecutive days. Results: A non-linear temperature-demand association was shown across the clusters, with ED visits increasing at higher temperatures. Model fit varied across clusters (R2 0.389-0.672), and the reference model consistently outperformed naive baselines. During two heatwaves in 2025, prediction errors remained within acceptable ranges. Baseline demand, heatwave occurrence, and model performance varied substantially within the canton. Conclusions: These findings have implications for the design of HHAPs, suggesting that emergency care preparedness should rely on locally calibrated demand forecast rather than standardized activation protocols.

items.title_en: Patterns and correlates of alcohol and other substance use among adults in two communities in Cape Town: a cross-sectional
items.title_zh: 开普敦两个社区成年人酒精和其他物质使用的模式和相关因素：一项横断面研究
items.abstract_en: Background We aimed to characterize substance use patterns, and their correlates, among adults with and without HIV at two healthcare facilities in Cape Town, South Africa. Methods We recruited adults with and without HIV from two primary healthcare facilities. We assessed alcohol use with the AUDIT-C and other substance use with the WHO-ASSIST questionnaires. We classified participants with no lifetime drug use and no or low-risk alcohol use as "low risk" and fitted latent class models among remaining participants to identify additional substance use patterns. We used multinomial logistic regression to examine factors associated with substance use patterns. Results Among 602 participants, 265 (44.0%) were "low risk". Latent class analysis among the remaining 337 identified three patterns: "higher-risk alcohol use" (N=168; 27.9%), "cannabis use" (universal cannabis use with mixed alcohol risk; N=114; 18.9%), and "mixed illicit drug use" (predominantly no or low-risk alcohol use with use of multiple drugs; N=55; 9.1%). Participants younger than 45 years were less likely to be in the low-risk group. Male sex was associated with lower probability of the low-risk group and higher probability of the higher-risk alcohol use and cannabis use classes. HIV was associated with higher probability of higher-risk alcohol use. One facility had a substantially higher probability of mixed illicit drug use. Conclusions We identified distinct higher-risk substance use profiles that varied strongly by age, sex, and facility. These findings support integrating alcohol and substance use screening and management into primary care and tailoring responses to local substance use patterns.

items.title_en: Back to work MD - Experiences of internal medicine physicians returning to work after parental leave
items.title_zh: 重返工作岗位的医学博士——内科医生在育儿假后重返工作的经历
items.abstract_en: BackgroundParenthood in medicine is an experience fraught with challenges that begin in the pre-conception phase and persist as physician-parents navigate their dual role. MethodsThis study aims to understand the experiences of physician-parents (both childbearing and non-childbearing) returning to work after parental leave. Physicians, including residents, affiliated with the University of Torontos Department of Medicine internal medicine division who had a child within the last ten years were invited to participate in a self-administered electronic survey from June2022 to 30June 2023. Data were summarized using descriptive statistics. ResultsTwenty-nine respondents took part in the survey; 79% were staff physicians while the remaining were trainees at the time of the survey. At the time their first child was born, 48% were staff members and 52% were trainees. The median duration of parental leave was 5 months (range 1-12 months). Among those for whom lactation was applicable, 76% reported that they continued their lactation efforts on returning to work, while 24% chose not to. Thirty five percent (35%, n=6/17) of respondents cited that they were not provided with duty hour modifications when required. Many respondents (46%) felt guilty about burdening their co-workers for requesting accommodations for childcare. When requested to rate their experiences of balancing their personal and professional lives on a scale of 1-10 (1 being "impossible to maintain" and 10 being "extremely easy to maintain"), most respondents (66%) chose a rating of 5 or less. ConclusionThis study supports previous findings that physician-parents face a myriad of challenges integrating their roles in medicine and parenthood. A change in culture is required to support and normalize parenthood for physicians and foster sustainability and productivity in academic medicine.

items.title_en: Inhalation exposure to methamphetamine in contaminated residences
items.title_zh: 污染住宅中甲基苯丙胺的吸入暴露
items.abstract_en: Current health risk assessments from thirdhand exposure to methamphetamine (meth) to occupants of contaminated residences when no cooking or use is still occurring assume that inhalation exposure is insignificant. After Wright et al. (2021) reported substantial meth concentrations in a contaminated residence, the present study was conducted to further test the hypothesis that concentrations were high enough to contribute to total occupant dose. Air sampling was conducted in contaminated residences that had been previously sampled for surface contamination. Samples were collected on personal sampling pumps in fixed locations on treated glass fiber filters is cassettes and analyzed by gas or liquid chromatography with mass spectroscopy. Sixty-nine samples were collected from eighteen residences for the study. Meth concentrations ranged from 0.02 to 15 ug/m3. Concentrations in supply air vents were significantly higher than in return vents or in ambient air. Residences with no HVAC systems (baseboard heat) had airborne concentrations similar to residences with HVAC systems turned off, and lower than when HVAC was on. Whether a residence was occupied or not did not show differences. All data from residences with HVAC had a significant correlation with surface concentrations (R2 = 0.61) but some factors that affected results were not determined in the study. In the context of the risk assessment and regulatory standard established by California and adopted in several other states, the inhalation exposure would approximately double total occupant dose for infants, and this population would exceed the California reference dose by approximately 100%. Further studies should be conducted to refine these estimates and determine the factors that influence airborne concentrations.

items.title_en: DyssomniaNN: Multi-Scale Spiking Neural Modeling of Human Sleep Disorders and Perceived Restedness
items.title_zh: DyssomniaNN：人类睡眠障碍与感知休息感的多尺度脉冲神经建模
items.abstract_en: Clinical sleep medicine repeatedly documents profound divergences between objective sleep duration and subjective daytime impairment, notably exemplified by sleep state misperception in paradoxical insomnia and boundary instability in narcolepsy type 1. Here, we present DyssomniaNN: a multi-scale biophysical computational framework coupling Borbély's two-process regulation of sleep homeostasis and circadian drive with Saper's hypothalamic reciprocal flip-flop circuit and a recurrent corticothalamic leaky integrate-and-fire spiking neural network. We formalize five clinical cohorts across an identical 72-hour photoperiod: healthy control, circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorder (delayed-phase), chronic insomnia, paradoxical insomnia, and narcolepsy type 1. The synthetic local field potential converges closely with empirical human electroencephalography spectra from the PhysioNet Sleep-EDF database across all canonical frequency bands (spectral mean absolute error of 0.33--0.35). Furthermore, we introduce the Well-Rested Index to quantify restorative efficacy. Simulations reveal that sleep duration fails to predict restorative recovery: paradoxical insomnia achieves normal total sleep time (21.15 h) yet yields low restoration (37.6%) from unsuppressed cortical beta-band intrusion, whereas hypocretin deficiency in narcolepsy produces severe nocturnal fragmentation (781 min of wake after sleep onset) and 35 sleep-onset rapid eye movement periods. DyssomniaNN provides an in silico platform for mechanistic sleep research and virtual neuropharmacology.

items.title_en: Designing Protein Structures from Natural Language
items.title_zh: 用自然语言设计蛋白质结构
items.abstract_en: A central challenge in de novo protein design is generating proteins with desired structural and functional properties. Existing design models typically require a dedicated input representation for each property, limiting the design objectives they support. We develop Prompteina, the first all-atom structure generation model that supports new and broader design objectives specified in natural language, analogous to text-to-image generation. To train Prompteina, we construct Prompteina-Data, a paired text--protein structure dataset of 1.8M structures and 50M+ captions describing global and residue-specific structural and functional properties. We adapt Proteina-Complexa, a pretrained structure generation model, through text-conditioned pretraining and finetuning that aligns residues with their corresponding text. Prompteina outperforms baselines on 15 of 18 structural properties and generates proteins that more closely match descriptions of their intended functions. In binder design, it leads baselines on at least 13 of 20 targets and improves interface confidence by 14\% over the strongest baseline. With iterative in silico feedback, Prompteina's gain over non-iterative generation is 57\% larger than the next-best baseline on the hardest targets. Finally, we experimentally validate Prompteina designs against GM2A, a target with no reported de novo binders. We identify nine binders, with the strongest at an apparent $K_{\mathrm{D}}$ of 107 nM. These results establish natural language as an effective and powerful conditioning interface for protein structure generation.
items.abstract_zh: 从头蛋白质设计的一个核心挑战是生成具备所需结构与功能性质的蛋白质。现有设计模型通常要为每种性质设置专门的输入表示，限制了所能支持的设计目标。我们开发了Prompteina——首个支持以自然语言指定新的、更广泛设计目标的全原子结构生成模型，类似于文生图生成。为训练Prompteina，我们构建了Prompteina-Data：一个包含180万个结构和5000万条以上配文的文本—蛋白质结构配对数据集，配文描述了全局与残基特异性的结构及功能性质。我们通过文本条件预训练与微调（将残基与其对应文本对齐）改造了预训练结构生成模型Proteina-Complexa。Prompteina在18项结构性质中的15项上优于基线，并生成与其预期功能描述更相符的蛋白质。在结合子（binder）设计中，它在20个靶点中至少13个上领先基线，界面置信度比最强基线提升14%。借助迭代式计算机反馈，在最难靶点上，Prompteina相对非迭代生成的增益比次优基线大57%。最后，我们针对GM2A（此前无报道过的从头结合子）进行了实验验证，鉴定出9个结合子，最强者的表观KD为107 nM。这些结果确立了自然语言是蛋白质结构生成的有效而强大的条件接口。
items.highlight_zh: 首个用自然语言条件生成全原子蛋白质结构的模型
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：从头设计蛋白质时，想控制哪一种性质就得换一套专门的输入表示，很难灵活地同时指定多个设计目标。
- 方法：提出Prompteina，首个支持自然语言条件的全原子蛋白结构生成模型；构建Prompteina-Data数据集，含180万个结构、5000万条以上描述整体与残基层面性质的配文；在预训练模型Proteina-Complexa基础上做文本条件预训练，并微调使残基与其对应文本对齐。
- 结果：在18项结构性质中15项优于基线，生成的蛋白更符合其功能描述；结合子设计中在20个靶点里至少13个领先，界面置信度比最强基线高14%；配合迭代计算反馈，在最难靶点上的增益比次优基线大57%；实验验证针对GM2A（此前无人做出从头结合子）找到9个结合子，最强表观KD为107 nM。
- 为何重要：把“文生图”的范式搬到蛋白质设计，让自然语言成为统一、灵活的设计接口，大幅扩展了可表达的设计目标。

items.title_en: PhySeqNet: physics-informed fluorescent foci detection for BARseq spatial transcriptomics
items.title_zh: PhySeqNet：用于BARseq空间转录组学的物理信息荧光焦点检测
items.abstract_en: BARseq enables spatially resolved gene-expression profiling across intact tissue, but its sensitivity depends on accurate detection and decoding of dense fluorescent rolonies. Existing spot-calling approaches can be conservative where signals overlap, while supervised deep learning is limited by the lack of reliable manual ground truth in real tissue images. Here we present PhySeqNet, a physics-informed deep learning framework for annotation-free fluorescent foci detection in BARseq. PhySeqNet trains U-Net detectors entirely on semi-synthetic images generated from an instrument-matched optical model combined with real sample-free experimental noise, and is integrated into pyBARseq, a modular Python pipeline for BARseq analysis. PhySeqNet achieved high detection performance on held-out simulated data across wavelength bands. On real tissue images, where ground truth is unavailable, we evaluated detections by forward-model reconstruction: PhySeqNet with conservative barcode-aware non-maxima suppression (NMSB) achieved higher reconstruction fidelity (NCC and MS-SSIM) than the BarDensr single-shot estimator, tuned classical spot detectors, and a pretrained deep-learning detector. In the analyzed brain section, PhySeqNet with NMSB yielded a median of 51 counts per cell versus 47 for BarDensr, with a similar number of genes detected per cell. The recovered transcripts produced spatial expression patterns qualitatively consistent with Allen MERFISH reference data and preserved cell-type composition after scANVI label transfer. These results show that physics-informed simulation can train practical, annotation-free detectors that improve BARseq sensitivity without disrupting downstream biological interpretation.

items.title_en: RetroTAC: Learning Route-Derived Synthetic Accessibility for PROTACs
items.title_zh: RetroTAC：学习用于PROTAC的路线衍生合成可及性
items.abstract_en: Proteolysis-targeting chimeras (PROTACs) enable targeted protein degradation, expanding therapeutic opportunities beyond conventional inhibition. However, assembling their large, multifunctional structures creates synthetic challenges that hinder their discovery. Traditional synthetic-accessibility scores can overestimate this difficulty by penalizing PROTACs' molecular complexity while overlooking modular assembly from accessible building blocks. In contrast, retrosynthesis planning tools provide explicit routes but are computationally expensive, particularly for large molecules. Here, we introduce a human-interpretable, PROTAC-oriented route-derived score that rewards short synthetic depth and balanced joining of molecular fragments, and RetroTAC, a machine-learning surrogate that predicts this score directly from molecular structures. RetroTAC combines complementary models in an ensemble, achieving a root mean squared error of 0.13 and an $R^2$ of 0.65 on held-out molecules. We further evaluate its utility on PROTACs enumerated by recombining warheads, linkers, and E3-ligase ligands, followed by retrosynthetic planning and route analysis. Candidates selected for high predicted scores achieve a mean route-derived synthesizability of 0.73, compared with 0.31 for low-score candidates; 98.75% versus 51.00% are fully resolved under the tested search settings. These results support RetroTAC as a fast prioritization tool for virtual PROTAC libraries, connecting molecular screening with interpretable route characteristics while reserving explicit planning for selected candidates.

items.title_en: A new device for live cell imaging of biological samples under in-plane shear
items.title_zh: 一种用于面内剪切下生物样本活细胞成像的新装置
items.abstract_en: The effect of mechanical stresses and deformations upon the behavior and properties of cells and tissues is a topic of paramount interest in the field of biophysics. Its understanding is essential for deepening our comprehension of cellular responses to environmental stimuli, with implications in fields ranging from embryogenesis to tumor development. For boosting the understanding in this field, it is important to develop devices for the application of simple deformations in order to probe the cellular response to the basic mechanical transformations. While a number of stretching devices have been developed, in-plane shearing deformation has been little investigated. Here, a new device is introduced that allows the application of homogeneous in-plane shear upon a cell monolayer while imaging the sample with a commercial optical microscope. A description of the faced experimental challenges is reported and a full characterization is presented. It is demonstrated the capability of the device to apply reproducible, controlled and homogeneous shear of both single cells and confluent cellular monolayers.

items.title_en: EEG Entrainment to Non-Speech Rhythmic Patterns Associated with Dimensions of Language Performance
items.title_zh: 与语言表现维度相关的非言语节律模式的EEG夹带
items.abstract_en: Developmental dyslexia (DLX) affects 5-12% of the global population and impairs learning to read. Its biological basis, particularly the difficulties observed in oral phonological tasks, remains debated. Entrainment, the coupling of brain oscillations to speech rhythms, is essential for encoding phonological representations. We investigated whether brain entrainment to non-speech rhythms could predict DLX in 48 participants listening to white noise amplitude-modulated at rates matching Spanish speech units. Phase-amplitude coupling (PAC) analysis of electroencephalography (EEG) signals yielded accurate DLX prediction for the 40 Hz stimulus using the Heights Ratio PAC measure (balanced accuracy 0.929, p = 0.0069, in the best case), indicating a stronger phonemic entrainment deficit in dyslexic individuals. Regression analysis in control (CTL) participants showed a strong dependence between reading performance scores and greater entrainment in language-associated brain regions. In particular, participants with poorer phonemic awareness, reading comprehension, or rapid automatized naming showed greater right-hemisphere entrainment to the 40 Hz stimulus. This finding adds evidence for the hemispheric compensatory mechanisms hypothesized in the literature. In conclusion, our methodology identifies dyslexia-specific entrainment patterns near language-associated brain regions, together with compensatory entrainment in right-hemisphere areas.

items.title_en: An entangling Hubbard quasiparticle collider on a digital quantum processor
items.title_zh: 数字量子处理器上的纠缠Hubbard准粒子对撞机
items.abstract_en: Scattering of quasiparticles provides direct access to the interactions that govern strongly correlated systems. In this work, we realize the quasiparticle scattering experiment of the Fermi-Hubbard model on a digital quantum processor by colliding a doublon and a holon in the half-filled chain of 21 sites encoded on 42 qubits of the ibm_boston processor. For the first time, we measure the transmission probability of quasiparticles of the Hubbard model on quantum hardware, which agrees with the Bethe-ansatz scattering matrix without free parameters. Beyond the scattering probabilities, the collision generates entanglement by superposing the transmitted and reflected components, which we infer from the particle-number fluctuation. In sharp contrast, a control collision between two doublons shows neither the interaction dependence nor the number fluctuation, as expected for indistinguishable particles. Our work demonstrates that the ability to create quasiparticles of a chosen flavor on demand and program their motion and interactions makes a digital quantum processor a new experimental toolset for probing the entanglement structure generated by quasiparticle scattering.
items.abstract_zh: 准粒子散射可直接探测支配强关联体系的相互作用。本工作中，我们在数字量子处理器上实现了Fermi-Hubbard模型的准粒子散射实验：在ibm_boston处理器的42个量子比特上编码半填充的21格点链，让一个doublon（双占据子）与一个holon（空穴子）相碰撞。我们首次在量子硬件上测量了Hubbard模型准粒子的透射概率，其结果与无自由参数的Bethe-ansatz散射矩阵一致。除散射概率外，该碰撞通过叠加透射与反射分量产生纠缠，我们由粒子数涨落推断出这一纠缠。与之形成鲜明对比的是，两个doublon之间的对照碰撞既无相互作用依赖，也无粒子数涨落，符合不可区分粒子的预期。本工作表明，按需创建选定类型的准粒子并编程其运动与相互作用的能力，使数字量子处理器成为探测准粒子散射所产生纠缠结构的新型实验工具。
items.highlight_zh: 量子硬件首测Hubbard准粒子透射概率并观测散射纠缠
items.digest_zh:
- 研究问题：强关联电子体系的物理由准粒子之间的相互作用主导，但在真实材料里直接做准粒子“对撞”实验极其困难：量子处理器能否充当可控的散射实验平台？
- 方法：在IBM的ibm_boston数字量子处理器上，用42个量子比特编码21个格点半填充的Fermi-Hubbard链，按需制备一个doublon（双占据）和一个holon（空穴），程序化地让两者碰撞；同时用两个doublon的碰撞作为对照。
- 结果：首次在量子硬件上测出Hubbard准粒子的透射概率，结果与不含任何自由参数的Bethe-ansatz散射矩阵吻合；碰撞把透射与反射分量叠加起来产生纠缠，可从粒子数涨落中读出；而对照的两个doublon碰撞既无相互作用依赖也无数涨落，正如不可区分粒子所应有。
- 为何重要：它展示了“按需造准粒子、并编程其运动与相互作用”的能力，使数字量子处理器成为研究准粒子散射所生成纠缠结构的新型实验工具。

items.title_en: A Warped Born Rule Turns an Observer into a Maxwell's Demon
items.title_zh: 扭曲的玻恩规则把观测者变成麦克斯韦妖
items.abstract_en: Quantum mechanics seems to be an incredibly delicate theory. Slight alterations to nearly any part of its structure can lead to huge qualitative differences and wildly unphysical predictions. Here, we explore the many-body consequences of replacing the Born rule $p(m)\propto\|P_m|ψ\rangle|^2$ by a warped rule $p_b(m)\propto\|P_m|ψ\rangle\|^{2b}$. Specifically, in systems with conserved particle number, evolution punctuated by repeated local particle observations acquires a probabilistic bias over measurement histories with an effect controlled by the sign of $b-1$. For $b>1$, this bias generically drives the gas to collect into nearly frozen configurations. Similar to the action of Maxwell's demon, the simple act of observation seems to extract entropy from a closed system. For $b<1$, the bias is reversed, generically scouring out long-wavelength fluctuations to produce a hyperuniform gas. We study this effect in a one-dimensional quantum gas, where these two phases are derived analytically for a particular measurement scheme and corroborated numerically for more general procedures with discrete-time projective-measurement circuit models using matrix product state simulations. We additionally discuss how this bias manifests in a common technique that often employs this warped rule, the ``replica trick,'' implying qualitative differences between finite-replica and replica-limit calculations.
items.abstract_zh: 量子力学似乎是一门极其精妙的理论，对其结构中几乎任何部分的细微改动都可能带来巨大的定性差异和严重违背物理的预言。本文探讨把玻恩规则 p(m) ∝ ‖P_m|ψ⟩‖² 替换为扭曲规则 p_b(m) ∝ ‖P_m|ψ⟩‖^{2b} 后的多体后果。具体而言，在粒子数守恒的系统中，被反复局域粒子观测打断的演化会对测量历史产生概率偏置，其效应由 b−1 的符号控制。当 b>1 时，这种偏置通常驱使气体聚集成近乎冻结的构型，犹如麦克斯韦妖的作用，单纯的观测行为似乎从封闭系统中提取了熵；当 b<1 时偏置反转，长波涨落被清除，形成超均匀气体。作者在一维量子气体中研究该效应：对特定测量方案解析推导出这两个相，并用基于矩阵乘积态的离散时间投影测量电路模型对更一般的程序做数值验证。文中还讨论了该偏置在常用技术“复制技巧”（replica trick）中的体现，意味着有限复制与复制极限计算之间存在定性差异。
items.highlight_zh: 扭曲玻恩规则让观测从封闭气体中抽取熵，观测者成了麦克斯韦妖
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么】玻恩规则（概率正比于波函数振幅平方）被视为量子力学的基石，改动它通常会得出严重非物理的结论。本文故意把指数 2 推广为 2b，考察多体系统会发生什么。
【用了什么方法】考虑粒子数守恒的系统，让演化过程反复被局域粒子数测量打断，并给每条测量历史赋予扭曲概率 p_b(m) ∝ ‖P_m|ψ⟩‖^{2b}。对一维量子气体，作者先对一种特定测量方案做解析推导，再用矩阵乘积态（MPS）模拟离散时间投影测量电路，验证更一般的测量流程。
【有什么结果】相的行为由 b−1 的符号决定：b>1 时，概率偏置被放大的是那些看似“粒子聚拢、近乎冻结”的测量历史，效果上像有只麦克斯韦妖从封闭系统里抽走熵；b<1 时偏置反转，长波涨落被清除，气体变成密度涨落被极大压制的“超均匀”态。作者还指出，量子计算中常用的“复制技巧”（replica trick）本质上也在使用这种扭曲规则，因此有限复制数与复制极限的结果可能有定性差别。
【为何重要】它说明量子理论对玻恩规则的改动异常敏感，把“观测”与热力学第二定律的关系放到聚光灯下，同时为超均匀物态以及复制技巧的计算含义提供了新视角。

items.title_en: A scalable sample-based quantum diagonalization solver for general Pauli-sum Hamiltonians
items.title_zh: 面向一般泡利和哈密顿量的可扩展采样量子对角化求解器
items.abstract_en: A scalable ground-state solver to be used in sample-based quantum diagonalization (SQD) is presented. The solver is built on JAX API, and is intended to be run on GPU platforms and possibly many-GPU high-performance computing facilities. It is capable of subspace diagonalization in up to $2^{30}$-dimensional subspace, with possible upgrades to enable even larger-scale operations. The two main components, a general-purpose eigensolver and an SQD-specific matrix-vector operation function, are described in detail. Efficiency of the eigensolver with respect to the GPU memory is demonstrated using a simple physics model. Furthermore, good strong scaling of the eigensolver in many-GPU environment is observed.
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种可用于基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）的可扩展基态求解器。该求解器基于 JAX API 构建，目标运行于 GPU 平台，并可用于多 GPU 高性能计算设施。它能够对最高 2^30 维的子空间进行对角化，并有望通过升级支持更大规模的运算。文中详细描述了两个主要组成部分：一个通用本征求解器，以及一个 SQD 专用的矩阵-向量运算函数。作者用一个简单的物理模型展示了该本征求解器在 GPU 内存方面的效率，并在多 GPU 环境中观察到良好的强扩展性。
items.highlight_zh: JAX+GPU求解器可在2^30维子空间做对角化，多GPU强扩展良好
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么】基于采样的量子对角化（SQD）是一种量子-经典混合的基态求解思路：先用采样（可来自量子设备）在庞大的希尔伯特空间中挑出少数重要构型，再在这块子空间里经典地对哈密顿量做对角化。瓶颈往往在经典一侧——子空间可能大到难以处理，因此需要一个能扩展到 GPU 集群的高效求解器。
【用了什么方法】作者用 JAX API 实现了一个面向 GPU 和多 GPU 高性能计算环境的求解器，包含两个核心组件：一是通用的迭代式本征求解器；二是 SQD 专用的矩阵-向量乘法函数，它直接作用在采样得到的构型集合所张成的子空间上。借助 JAX 的即时编译与自动并行，计算可以分布到多块 GPU。
【有什么结果】求解器能处理高达 2^30 维的子空间，且留有继续升级的空间；在一个简单物理模型上验证了 GPU 显存使用效率；在多 GPU 环境下展现出良好的强扩展性，即问题规模固定时增加 GPU 能按比例缩短求解时间。
【为何重要】SQD 的实用化关键在于经典后处理能否跟上。把子空间对角化做成可扩展的 GPU 求解器，意味着更大、更真实的量子化学与多体问题有望用“含噪量子采样 + 经典对角化”的路线在当下求解，是混合量子计算走向实用的一项关键基础设施，同时也对一般泡利和形式的哈密顿量通用。

items.title_en: Quantum Query Complexity of Maximum Degree and its Generalizations
items.title_zh: 最大度及其推广的量子查询复杂度
items.abstract_en: We study the quantum query complexity of several basic graph problems. 1) We prove a tight $Θ(n^{3/2})$ bound for finding a maximum-out-degree vertex in an $n$-vertex tournament, resolving a conjecture of Mande, Paraashar, and Saurabh [FSTTCS'23]. 2) Using the same proof idea, we give a direct proof that finding a maximum-degree vertex in an $n$-vertex undirected graph requires $Θ(n^{3/2})$ quantum queries, a bound implicit in the work of Apers and Lee [CCC'21]. Both lower bounds above hold even for computing only the maximum degree or maximum out-degree. 3) We also study Maximum $(k,n-k)$-Cut, which asks for the largest cut with one side of size $k$. For every constant $k\geq 1$, we give an $O(n^{2-1/(k+1)})$-query quantum algorithm. 4) We establish a reduction to Maximum $(k,n-k)$-Cut involving $k$-Graph Collision, which asks whether the marked vertices of a known graph contain a $k$-clique. For $k\geq 3$, this yields unconditional lower bounds with exponents strictly larger than $3/2$, showing that this problem is strictly harder than computing maximum degree. Additionally, under a conjecture we propose for $k$-Graph Collision, the reduction yields a lower bound matching our upper bound above.

items.title_en: Maximally antiflat fixed-particle-number fermionic states
items.title_zh: 最大反平坦固定粒子数费米子态
items.abstract_en: Fermionic Gaussian states are completely characterized by their two-point correlations, making the covariance matrix a natural reference for quantifying non-Gaussian structure. Motivated by fermionic antiflatness, we study its extremal form for pure number-conserving states and ask which states can be maximally antiflat and how they can be constructed. We show that, at fixed particle number, maximal first antiflatness is equivalent to a completely flat one-body reduced density matrix, and we obtain a complete existence classification together with explicit block and cyclic-orbit constructions of all allowed sectors. We then investigate the structure that appears beyond the covariance level. Maximally antiflat states with identical one-body data can exhibit distinct connected four-point correlations, which we characterize through the four-point Majorana Wick error and, equivalently, the connected two-body reduced density matrix cumulant. We show that this quartic structure is necessarily nonzero and formulate its extremization as a two-body reduced density matrix (2RDM) purity problem. Combining this framework with a Hilbert--Schmidt estimate of Christiansen for truncated two-body correlations, we obtain an upper bound on the connected quartic structure in terms of first antiflatness. Our results establish both a complete characterization of maximal fermionic antiflatness at fixed particle number and a constrained hierarchy linking covariance-level flatness to higher-order non-Gaussian correlations.

items.title_en: An Annealing-based Quantum Neural Network with Discrete Wavelet Transforms for Enhanced Air Pollution Nowcasting
items.title_zh: 结合离散小波变换的退火量子神经网络用于增强空气污染临近预报
items.abstract_en: Air pollution poses a significant threat to public health, exacerbated by the rapid industrialization and urbanization of modern society. While traditional deep learning offers predictive capabilities, recent advancements in quantum machine learning (QML) present a compelling alternative. Here, we introduce a scalable hybrid framework that integrates variational quantum circuits with quantum annealing. Leveraging a neuromorphic quantum computing platform to transcend the qubit limitations of the NISQ era, we model particulate matter (PM$_{2.5}$) dynamics using high-density urban data from the UK. We demonstrate that our Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) exhibit an intrinsic resilience to input volatility, significantly outperforming classical baselines (MLP and LSTM) on raw, high-entropy environmental data. Furthermore, we successfully scaled the model to 172 qubits, observing a synergistic enhancement when coupled with wavelet decomposition that achieves state-of-the-art predictive fidelity. These findings establish a critical benchmark for quantum utility, proving that scalable, neuromorphic quantum machine learning can now address complex, non-linear real-world problems.
items.abstract_zh: 空气污染对公共健康构成重大威胁，并因现代社会的快速工业化与城市化而加剧。传统深度学习虽具备预测能力，但量子机器学习（QML）的最新进展提供了颇具吸引力的替代方案。本文提出一个可扩展的混合框架，将变分量子电路与量子退火相结合。借助神经形态量子计算平台突破 NISQ 时代的量子比特限制，我们利用英国的高密度城市数据对 PM2.5 动态进行建模。结果表明，我们的量子神经网络（QNN）对输入波动具有内在韧性，在原始、高熵的环境数据上显著优于经典基线（MLP 和 LSTM）。此外，我们成功将模型扩展到 172 个量子比特，并观察到与小波分解耦合时的协同增强，达到了最先进的预测精度。这些发现为量子实用性建立了关键基准，证明可扩展的神经形态量子机器学习现已能够解决复杂的非线性现实问题。
items.highlight_zh: 结合小波变换的量子神经网络将PM2.5预测扩展到172量子比特并超越经典基线
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么】空气污染（尤其 PM2.5）危害健康，需要准确的短期预报（nowcasting）。经典深度学习模型（MLP、LSTM）在原始、噪声大、熵高的环境监测数据上表现受限。作者想验证：混合量子机器学习能否在真实城市数据上做得更好。
【用了什么方法】提出一个可扩展的混合框架，把变分量子电路与量子退火结合起来，运行在“神经形态量子计算”平台上，以绕过 NISQ 时代的量子比特数量限制。输入数据来自英国高密度城市监测网络；此外还引入离散小波变换，把污染时间序列做多尺度分解后再送入量子神经网络（QNN）。
【有什么结果】QNN 对输入波动表现出内在韧性，在未经平滑的原始高熵数据上显著优于 MLP 和 LSTM 基线；模型成功扩展到 172 个量子比特；与小波分解耦合时出现协同增强，达到当时的先进预测精度。
【为何重要】这是一次面向真实世界复杂非线性问题的“量子实用性”演示，说明可扩展的神经形态量子学习已可承担实际预测任务，也提示小波等多尺度信号处理与量子模型结合是有效策略。需要注意的是，“超越经典”的结论建立在特定数据集、任务设定与基线配置之上。

items.title_en: Bicycle Race: small two-block codes on the Pareto frontier
items.title_zh: Bicycle Race：帕累托前沿上的小二块码
items.abstract_en: Two-block group-algebra codes are among the simplest quantum LDPC codes, and many of them are translation invariant on a twisted torus, which suits neutral-atom arrays and other platforms with movable qubits. We ask how far they go at small sizes when searched systematically across all groups. To tackle this question, we use a series of algebraic constraints and screens to design a search pipeline capable of enumerating broad and complete swathes of two-block codes on a laptop. With it we census about $10^8$ two-block codes with up to $320$ qubits at check weights five to nine. Several of these censuses are exhaustive, and support complete statements; for instance, the Gross code is, up to equivalence, the only abelian weight-six two-block code with $n \le 200$ to reach $kd^2/n=12$, and the known $[[64,18,8]]$ is the best two-block code by $kd^2/n$ across weights five to nine with $n \le 94$. The censuses are also large enough to give insights into where good codes live - they concentrate in a handful of groups; abelian groups give the best codes at small $n$ and non-abelian groups at large $n$, with the crossover appearing to move out as the check weight grows; and high quality codes become $100$ to $1000$ times rarer per draw from weight six to weights eight and nine. Using the group algebra and the census data to steer a statistical search finds four to fifteen times as many good codes as uniform draws in equal time. Among the codes found are $[[102,20,10]]$ and $[[120,24,10]]$ at check weight nine, which we simulate in noisy syndrome-extraction circuits, and $[[288,16,16]]$, the best weight-six two-block code with $n \le 300$. At check weights seven to nine, our best codes exceed the best published $kd^2/n$ with exact distance at the same check weight in most length bands up to $320$ qubits. All codes are available in a public database.

items.title_en: GPU-Based Parallel BP Decoding for Quantum LDPC Memory
items.title_zh: 基于GPU的量子LDPC存储并行BP解码
items.abstract_en: Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) decoding requires reliable corrections and low latency over long syndrome histories. We extend BP-SF, an oscillation-guided belief-propagation (BP) decoder with independent syndrome-flip trials, by introducing windowed and streaming operations. Our CUDA implementation combines disordered-memory retries, sliding windows, correlation-aware graphs, and layered scheduling. Circuit-level simulations test fixed-basis memory and complete logical Pauli-frame recovery. On the [[144,12,12]] bivariate bicycle code at physical error rate p = 0.002, parallel BP-SF reduces 99.9th-percentile call latency by a factor of 13.15 relative to an eight-chain Relay-BP GPU baseline on 100,000 matched samples for which every tested method's initial BP stage fails within 80 iterations. Windowed BP-SF maintains a flat logical error rate and nearly constant per-round compute time through 512 rounds, reaching a 17.1-fold speedup over monolithic decoding. In 512-round full-frame streaming decoding with 2.97-ms syndrome arrivals, layered BP-SF on a transformed joint graph with 20 retries reduces 99.9th-percentile correction-release age from 166.29 to 36.25 ms relative to the joint graph with flooding updates and 100 retries. These results connect parallel BP post-processing to lower decoding costs and earlier correction release in streaming quantum memory.

items.title_en: Statistical Optical Replication and Mixing of Spatial Information across Wavelengths
items.title_zh: 跨波长的空间信息的统计光学复制与混合
