items.abstract_en: Accessing and combining the spatial information carried by light at different wavelengths is important for linking structured-light encoding with spectrally distinct detection channels. Here, we introduce a correlation-enabled linear-optical framework for cross-wavelength imaging, bidirectional replication, and spatial information mixing. Shared random holographic modulation establishes correlations between nondegenerate optical fields, allowing spatial information to be retrieved from joint intensity fluctuations. In the demonstrated replicator, a spatial pattern encoded at one wavelength is read out in the detection coordinates of another through intensity correlations. Selecting diffraction-order pairs produces correlation kernels containing either the product or the conjugate product of two input field envelopes. These operations reproduce the spatial algebra underlying sum- and difference-frequency generation, while the optical fields retain their original carrier frequencies. The theory accounts for wavelength-dependent propagation and coordinate scaling, linking the input structures to observable correlation patterns. Together, these results establish a common framework for cross-wavelength spatial information processing through engineered optical correlations and joint detection.

items.title_en: No advantage from classical assistance for energy-constrained bosonic dephasing channels
items.title_zh: 能量约束玻色退相干信道中经典辅助无优势
items.abstract_en: We prove that four capacities of single-mode bosonic dephasing channels coincide under an average photon-number constraint: the unassisted quantum capacity, the unassisted private capacity, the two-way classically assisted quantum capacity, and the two-way public-classically assisted private capacity. The assistance may be interactive: the parties can exchange classical messages between channel uses and choose subsequent inputs based on earlier outcomes. For every finite value of the constraint, their common value is the coherent information optimized over Fock-diagonal input states satisfying the constraint. The proof uses a relative entropy comparison with the completely dephasing channel to derive chain rules for the Rains relative entropy and the relative entropy of entanglement. These chain rules give an upper bound on the rates achievable by adaptive protocols whose mean input photon number is constrained on average over all channel uses. We also show that both chain rules are attained by canonical purifications of finite-energy Fock-diagonal states.

items.title_en: Enhanced analogue quantum computation with a logically-encoded XX gadget
items.title_zh: 利用逻辑编码的 XX gadget 的增强型模拟量子计算
items.abstract_en: The introduction of two-body XX interactions has been shown to improve the performance of quantum annealing in solving certain combinatorial optimisation problems and would enable the simulation of a broader class of many-body Hamiltonians. Due to experimental constraints, such interactions are typically not natively available on analogue quantum devices. To overcome this limitation we introduce the truss gadget. This is an exact construction that generates two-body XX interactions using only one-body X and Z fields and two-body ZZ interactions which are readily accessible on, for instance, superconducting quantum annealers. We experimentally validate the construction by reproducing the dynamics of a target XX Hamiltonian on a trapped-ion quantum processor. We then apply the gadget to an illustrative set of instances of the weighted maximum-independent-set problem on a superconducting quantum annealer. We empirically determine an approximate thousand-fold improvement in the probability of finding a state close to the ground state for these instances, over implementation without an XX interaction.

items.title_en: A Hardware-Native Trapped-Ion Hybrid Qudit-Oscillator Instruction Set
items.title_zh: 一种硬件原生囚禁离子混合 qudit-振子指令集
items.abstract_en: Scaling trapped-ion processors by adding ions remains challenging. A complementary route exploits the multilevel internal structure of each ion to increase the computational Hilbert space per ion. We introduce a hardware-native hybrid qudit-oscillator instruction set for a general d-level internal register coupled to bosonic modes and prove that three of its native operation families suffice for universality of one qudit coupled to several modes. Adding an entangling operation between ions extends universality to a connected register of several qudits. The architecture natively supports both phase-space and sideband instruction sets and is implemented in the open-source framework HybridLane. As a representative application, we reproduce the dissipative vibronic dynamics of a three-chromophore complex previously simulated on a hybrid qubit-oscillator superconducting platform. Moving from a one-qubit-per-state register to a single qudit stores the entire electronic manifold in one ion, so every electronic coupling becomes a local intra-ion transition and the lab-frame Hamiltonian compiles directly into the ISA. Under the stated sequential timing model from a 40Ca+ qudit processor, one Trotter step is projected to run about ten times faster on the qudit, with an average RMSE of approximately 1.1 percent against the published reference.

items.title_en: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
items.title_zh: QTestBench：评估大语言模型生成量子代码的测试框架
items.abstract_en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.
items.abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在经典代码生成上表现优异，也越来越多地被用来编写保护这些代码的单元测试。它们能否为量子软件做到同样的事尚不清楚，因为量子程序具有概率性、依赖数值容差、并由领域专用检查器判定，所以一个形式正确的测试仍可能与基准的判定不一致。现有量子基准衡量模型是否给出正确解，却不衡量其测试能否区分正确实现与错误实现。我们提出 QTestBench，一个把 LLM 生成的量子测试套件与独立基准检查器对照评估的框架，绝不把测试本身当作真值。对每个任务，QTestBench 提示模型生成语法、语义和行为测试，在运行时注入候选解，并在三个验证队列中把每个测试的判定与检查器标签比较，每个队列回答一个不同的诊断问题。我们在八个 PennyLane QHack 挑战和十个 Qiskit HumanEval 任务上对五个 LLM 做了基准测试。生成的测试套件几乎总能执行，但区分能力明显滞后：最佳生成器在 QHack 上的测试质量为 0.71，在 Qiskit HumanEval 上为 0.34，因此仅凭可执行性会高估测试质量。经 oracle 验证的合成变异体在自然错误解稀缺时（十个 Qiskit 任务中有三个未能产生）稳定了错误检测估计。QTestBench 为 LLM 生成量子测试的可信度提供了可复现的跨框架基准。
items.highlight_zh: 首个评测LLM生成量子测试区分能力的跨框架基准，最佳质量仅0.71
items.digest_zh:
【研究了什么】LLM 已经能写经典代码，也常被用来生成单元测试。但量子程序是概率性的、结果要靠数值容差判断、且由领域专用检查器（checker）定胜负——一个看起来“格式正确”的测试，判定结果仍可能与基准检查器相反。现有量子基准只测“模型能否写出正确解”，而不测“模型写的测试能否把正确实现和错误实现区分开”，这正是本文关注的空白。
【用了什么方法】作者提出 QTestBench：对每个任务，提示 LLM 生成语法、语义、行为三类测试；在运行时把候选解注入测试套件；再把每个测试给出的判定与独立基准检查器的标签逐一比对。关键设计是绝不把 LLM 生成的测试当作真值，而以外部的独立检查器为参照。评测分三个验证队列，各自回答一个不同的诊断问题。针对自然错误解稀缺的情况，还引入经 oracle 验证的合成变异体来稳定错误检测率的估计。
【有什么结果】在 5 个 LLM、8 个 PennyLane QHack 挑战和 10 个 Qiskit HumanEval 任务上评测。生成的测试套件几乎总能成功执行，但区分能力差得多：最好的生成器在 QHack 上测试质量仅 0.71，在 Qiskit HumanEval 上仅 0.34。也就是说，“能跑通”会严重高估测试质量。十个 Qiskit 任务中有三个根本没有自然错误解，必须靠合成变异体。
【为何重要】它提供了首个可复现、跨框架（PennyLane 与 Qiskit）的基准，用来评估 LLM 生成量子测试的可信度，提醒研究者和开发者不要用“可执行性”代替“有效性”，也为自动化量子软件测试的改进给出了可量化的诊断工具。

items.title_en: Diversity-Aware Ensemble of Quantum-Classical Models via Combinatorial Fusion
items.title_zh: 基于组合融合的多样性感知量子-经典模型集成
items.abstract_en: Variational quantum circuits (VQCs) are highly sensitive to circuit architecture, yet most quantum machine learning pipelines select a single best design and discard the remaining candidates. This paper addresses whether the structural diversity across quantum circuit search spaces can be used to produce stronger predictions through model fusion. We apply Combinatorial Fusion Analysis (CFA), a model fusion framework that selects and combines multiple scoring systems using rank-score function (RSF) and cognitive diversity (CD), to a pool of 29 architecturally diverse classical models and quantum circuits. Using a diversity-aware model selection method, we identify subsets of maximally diverse models and combine them with both score and rank combination. Experiments on four binary classification benchmarks covering different domains demonstrate that CFA-based hybrid classical-quantum fusion consistently outperform the best individual model on every dataset considered with improvements up to 6.03% in accuracy. When comparing with relevant literatures, the CFA framework further achieves superior performance across all four datasets.
items.abstract_zh: 变分量子电路（VQC）对电路结构高度敏感，但多数量子机器学习流程只保留单个最优设计，丢弃其余候选。本文考察能否利用量子电路搜索空间的结构多样性，通过模型融合获得更强预测。作者将组合融合分析（CFA）——一种借助秩-分数函数（RSF）与认知多样性（CD）来选择和组合多个评分系统的融合框架——用于29个结构多样的经典模型与量子电路。在四个不同领域的二分类基准上，基于CFA的经典-量子混合融合在每个数据集上都稳定优于最佳单体模型，准确率最高提升6.03%；与相关文献相比也在四个数据集上全面领先。
items.highlight_zh: 组合融合利用电路多样性，混合集成准确率最高提升6.03%
items.digest_zh:
「研究了什么问题」：量子机器学习中，变分量子电路（VQC）对架构极为敏感，不同设计表现差异很大；而常规做法是从搜索空间中挑一个最好的架构，把其余候选全部丢掉，白白浪费信息。
「用了什么方法」：作者把“模型融合”思路引入量子机器学习。具体采用组合融合分析（CFA）这一融合框架：它用秩-分数函数（RSF）刻画单个模型的打分行为，用认知多样性（CD）衡量模型之间的互补程度，再据此挑选出“最大程度互补”的模型子集，并以分数组合和秩组合两种方式把它们的输出合起来。实验池包含29个架构各异的模型，既有经典模型也有量子电路，因此可以做经典-量子混合融合。
「有什么结果」：在覆盖不同领域的四个二分类基准上，CFA混合融合在每一个数据集上都超过其中最好的单个模型，准确率最高提升6.03%；与文献中已有方法相比也全面占优。
「为何重要」：这说明量子电路搜索过程中被淘汰的“次优”设计并非无用——只要结构足够多样，就能作为互补信息被重新利用。它为量子机器学习提供了一条低成本的性能提升路径：不必设计更强的单个电路，而是善用已有候选的多样性；也为经典与量子模型的协同使用提供了可复用的选择准则。

items.title_en: Replica Transition at Measurement-Altered Ising Criticality
items.title_zh: 测量改变的伊辛临界性处的副本转变
items.abstract_en: Performing measurements on gapless quantum ground states can give rise to new universal phenomena, whose origins remain poorly understood even for the paradigmatic Ising critical point. Replica methods offer a natural framework to study such post-measurement ensembles, with the replica limit $Q\to 1$ describing physical Born-averaged observables. Here we show that, for the monitored critical Ising chain, the replicated post-measurement ensemble of states itself undergoes a phase transition precisely at the physically relevant replica limit $Q \to 1$, preventing standard replica treatments. We use boundary conformal field theory (BCFT) methods to explain the underlying mechanism of this transition. Our methods yield a perturbative analytic calculation of the universal $O(1)$ constant in the Shannon entropy of the measurement record, previously known only numerically. We also apply our tools to study measurement-averaged spin correlators, providing a unified description of the universal properties of measurement outcomes and post-measurement states in the critical Ising chain.

items.title_en: Improved screening of doped ZrO$_2$ catalysts for CO$_2$ hydrogenation from graph-based machine learning
items.title_zh: 基于图机器学习的掺杂ZrO₂催化剂CO₂加氢筛选改进
items.abstract_en: Dopants can tune the activity of zirconia-based CO$_2$ hydrogenation catalysts through changes in adsorbate and transition-state (TS) energetics. Computing these quantities with density functional theory (DFT) becomes expensive when several dopants, reaction intermediates, and TSs must be screened. Here, we further develop the graph-based machine learning method Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman Gaussian Process Regression (WWL-GPR): we introduce additional electronic-structure and local-environment features relevant for oxide surfaces and use the resulting model to predict adsorption and TS energies on ZrO$_2$(101) surfaces doped with Al$^{3+}$, Cd$^{2+}$, Ga$^{3+}$, In$^{3+}$, and Zn$^{2+}$. Adsorbate-surface structures are represented as attributed graphs that combine bonds connectivity and features. We benchmark WWL-GPR against thermodynamic scaling relations (TSR) for reaction intermediates and Bronsted-Evans-Polanyi relations (BEP) for TSs, and then propagate the predicted energies to microkinetic CH$_3$OH-yield estimates. WWL-GPR consistently improves the prediction of reaction intermediate energetics relative to linear scaling approaches and provides TS estimates that are competitive with BEP-based models. These improvements become especially relevant when the predicted energetics are propagated through the reaction network. Microkinetic calculations show that WWL-GPR-derived energies give CH$_3$OH yields closer to DFT-derived yields than the linear-relation workflow. Degree-of-rate-control analysis links the activity errors to dopant-dependent rate-controlling steps, including HCOO* formation, H$_2$COOH* dissociation, and H$_3$CO* formation. These results support WWL-GPR as a data-efficient surrogate for connecting atomistic energetics with catalyst-screening observables on doped oxide surfaces.
items.abstract_zh: 掺杂剂可通过改变吸附物与过渡态（TS）能量来调控氧化锆基CO₂加氢催化剂的活性，但当需要筛选多种掺杂剂、反应中间体与TS时，密度泛函理论（DFT）计算代价高昂。本文进一步发展基于图的机器学习方法WWL-GPR（Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman高斯过程回归），引入与氧化物表面相关的电子结构和局域环境特征，预测Al³⁺、Cd²⁺、Ga³⁺、In³⁺、Zn²⁺掺杂ZrO₂(101)表面的吸附能与TS能量，吸附物-表面结构被表示为结合键连接性与属性的图。结果显示，相对线性标度关系，WWL-GPR对反应中间体能量预测更准，TS估计可与BEP关系竞争；将预测能量输入微观动力学后，其CH₃OH产率比线性关系流程更接近DFT结果。速率控制度分析把活性误差归因于掺杂剂相关的控速步骤，如HCOO*生成、H₂COOH*解离与H₃CO*生成。
items.highlight_zh: 图机器学习WWL-GPR更准预测掺杂ZrO₂能量，CH₃OH产率接近DFT
items.digest_zh:
「研究了什么问题」：ZrO₂基催化剂上CO₂加氢制甲醇的活性，可以通过掺杂不同金属离子来调控。要筛选出好的掺杂剂，需要知道各种吸附物和过渡态（TS）的能量；但这些量要用密度泛函理论（DFT）逐个计算，掺杂剂×中间体×TS组合一多，成本就难以承受，因此需要廉价而准确的代理模型。
「用了什么方法」：作者改进了一种基于图的机器学习方法WWL-GPR（Wasserstein Weisfeiler-Lehman高斯过程回归）。它把吸附物-表面结构表示为带属性的图（既含原子间连接关系，也含特征），用Wasserstein距离比较图之间的相似性，再交给高斯过程回归预测能量。本文的改进在于加入与氧化物表面相关的电子结构与局域环境特征。研究对象是Al³⁺、Cd²⁺、Ga³⁺、In³⁺、Zn²⁺掺杂的ZrO₂(101)表面。
「有什么结果」：与线性标度做法相比，对反应中间体，WWL-GPR比热力学标度关系（TSR）预测更准；对过渡态，其表现可与Brønsted-Evans-Polanyi（BEP）关系竞争。更关键的是，把预测能量送入微观动力学模型后，所得CH₃OH产率比线性关系流程更接近DFT结果。速率控制度分析进一步指出，活性预测误差主要来自掺杂剂相关的控速步骤，如HCOO*生成、H₂COOH*解离和H₃CO*生成。
「为何重要」：这表明图机器学习能以数据高效的方式把原子尺度能量与催化剂筛选指标连接起来，让“先算准能量、再推产率”的筛选流程变得可行，为氧化物催化剂的高通量设计提供了实用工具。

items.title_en: Locality-Preparation Time Tradeoffs in Dissipative Quantum Systems
items.title_zh: 耗散量子系统中的局域性-制备时间权衡
items.abstract_en: Dissipative state preparation engineers quantum many-body states as steady states of an open-system dynamics. The spatial range of the required dissipation sets both the feasibility of analog implementations and the connectivity and control complexity of digital ones. Yet how this locality quantitatively constrains preparation times remains largely unknown. Here, we establish an exact locality-preparation time relation for quadratic fermionic systems and develop a construction that optimizes the locality of the dissipative dynamics while preserving the target state. Applied to the Kitaev chain, our framework reveals sharply different locality-preparation time tradeoffs in critical and gapped regimes. At criticality, suppressing the algebraic tails of the jump operators necessarily forces the preparation time to grow algebraically with system size. By contrast, both trivial and topological gapped phases admit exponentially localized dissipation with a finite preparation time in the thermodynamic limit. Our results identify when fast dissipative preparation is compatible with local control and when criticality imposes an unavoidable dynamical cost.

items.title_en: Chiroptical Nonlinearity Found in Covalent Organic Frameworks
items.title_zh: 共价有机框架中发现的手性光学非线性
items.abstract_en: Chiroptical nonlinearity is vital for modern optics and photonics. However, it remains a central challenge to obtain a material simultaneously with large second-order nonlinearity and strong nonlinear optical chirality. Here we uncover the strong chiroptical nonlinearity in COF-330-a, owing to the formation of unique chiral, polar structure with large p-electron conjugation via structural transformation. A large effective second-order nonlinear susceptibility of ~ 101 pm/V and a strong nonlinear chiroptical response (SHG-CD: -1.60 to +1.66) have been demonstrated in individual COF-330-a microcrystals, transcending the performance trade-off limitation in conventional chiroptical materials. These findings open a new avenue for designing nonlinear chiroptical crystals which harness the duality of polarity and chirality and chemical versatility of COFs.

items.title_en: Dynamical Lie Algebras for Fixed-Gate Quantum Ansätze
items.title_zh: 用于固定门量子拟设的动力学李代数
items.abstract_en: Parameterized Quantum Circuits have emerged as a central framework for variational quantum algorithms in the NISQ regime, with major applications in quantum simulation, combinatorial optimization, and, more recently, quantum machine learning (QML). By developing a new approach for computing dynamical Lie algebras associated with quantum circuits combining parametrized gates and non-parametrized entangling gates, we aim to extend the applicability of recent algebraic results to architectures that are actually used in quantum machine learning.

items.title_en: QTN-RQNN: Quantum Tensor Network-Based Recurrent Quantum Neural Network
items.title_zh: QTN-RQNN：基于量子张量网络的循环量子神经网络
items.abstract_en: Resource constraints and imperfect quantum operations remain major challenges for quantum machine learning (QML) on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices, particularly for fault-diagnosis tasks involving imbalanced and heterogeneous data. This work proposes QTN-RQNN, a Quantum Tensor Network-Based Recurrent Quantum Neural Network that integrates tensor-network-inspired nearest-neighbor interactions with recurrent quantum processing. The model sequentially encodes input features while propagating quantum memory across recurrent steps and incorporates QSMOTE for class balancing. QTN-RQNN is evaluated on four heterogeneous fault-diagnosis datasets SPID, CWRUBD, EFDD, and SFDD and compared with QNN, QTN-QNN, and RQNN baselines through classification, ablation, multi-seed, convergence, and quantum-resource analyses. Results show dataset-dependent predictive behavior, indicating that increased quantum architectural complexity does not universally improve classification. On SPID, QTN-RQNN improves the RQNN F1-score from 0.3077 to 0.4516 and ROC-AUC from 0.4485 to 0.6970, while the remaining datasets exhibit different performance-resource trade-offs and sensitivity to recurrent timesteps and circuit depth. Across all datasets, QTN-RQNN reduces the two-qubit-gate count from 32 to 24 per sample relative to RQNN, corresponding to a 25% reduction without increasing the four-qubit requirement; the same relative reduction is obtained for QTN-QNN over QNN. These findings establish QTN-RQNN as a resource-conscious recurrent quantum architecture and highlight the need to jointly consider predictive performance and circuit-resource requirements for near-term quantum fault diagnosis.

items.title_en: Judd-Ofelt analysis and coherent spectroscopy of europium-based molecular complexes for quantum information applications
items.title_zh: 用于量子信息应用的铕基分子配合物的 Judd-Ofelt 分析与相干光谱
items.abstract_en: Rare-earth-ion based molecular crystals are emerging as a promising platform for quantum information applications, combining long optical coherence times with the chemical tunability of coordination chemistry. Here we present a comprehensive optical characterisation of twelve Eu$^{3+}$-based molecular complexes, with a focus on the coherent $^{5}\text{D}_{0} \longrightarrow \ ^{7}\text{F}_{0}$ transition at $\sim$580 nm. Judd-Ofelt analyses are performed across all complexes, providing insights into ligand-field environments, local point-group symmetries, and the resulting branching ratios of the coherent transition. We find that lower point-group symmetry (C$_1$, C$_2$) yields higher branching ratios of the $^{5}\text{D}_{0} \longrightarrow \ ^{7}\text{F}_{0}$ transition, exceeding 1\% in several complexes. Optical inhomogeneous linewidths measured at 4.2 K reveal narrow linewidths for some complexes of below ten GHz, indicative of a highly ordered crystalline environment. Optical coherence measurements of one of the complexes, 5-Eu, yields an optical coherence time of $T_{\text{2}}^{\text{opt}} = 2.3~μ\mathrm{s}$ at 4.2 K, comparable to the best-performing molecular systems reported to date. Systematic characterisation and quantitative comparison will be key to find structure-property relations guiding rational design of optimised complexes for quantum information applications.

items.title_en: Finite-Size Limits of Adaptive Pauli Prediction
items.title_zh: 自适应泡利预测的有限尺寸极限
items.abstract_en: Can quantum data reliably answer questions chosen from earlier results? We prove that $M$ adaptive Pauli predictions on $n$ qubits require $Ω(\sqrt{\min\{n,M\}})$ copies at fixed accuracy. Published upper bounds make this tight for $M\le n$. Thus $n$ adaptive predictions cost $Θ(\sqrt n)$ copies, whereas a fixed list costs only $O(\log n)$. The lower bound uses diagonal states and commuting observables, identifying a statistical cost of adaptation. We also quantify how this cost increases with precision.

items.title_en: Parametric Glassiness in Graphene-based Electronic Lévy Glass
items.abstract_en: Complex disordered conductors can display highly structured and parameter-sensitive transport even in the absence of a thermodynamically stable glass phase. Overlap distributions originally developed for replica symmetry breaking (RSB) provide a useful diagnostic of this organization, provided that their interpretation is distinguished from the equilibrium Parisi construction. In this study, we report RSB-like overlap phenomenology and parametric mesoscopic glassiness in a graphene-based electronic Lévy glass, a device that mimics optical phenomena via electronic processes. By tuning the Fermi energy, we can control the number of propagating wave modes and observe reentrant changes from narrowly centered to broad or bimodal overlap distributions. The phenomenology is observed in both graphene-based and conventional two-dimensional electron-gas electronic Lévy glasses, indicating its generality. Sample-resolved overlap distributions show that the effect is intrinsic to each disorder landscape, whereas the normalized conductance variance shows that the growth of the absolute variance is mainly caused by the increasing mean conductance. We therefore interpret the overlap as a measure of correlation among hierarchically organized transport pathways and the reentrant behavior as evidence of pinning, parameter-induced reorganizations, and mesoscopic chaos in coherent transport.

items.title_en: Operational signatures of exceptional quantum channels
items.abstract_en: Exceptional points (EPs) are usually introduced as defective degeneracies of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians and, in fully open quantum dynamics, of Liouvillian generators. Here we formulate an operational theory of exceptional points that does not invoke a Hamiltonian or a master equation. The primitive dynamical object is a completely positive trace-preserving (CPTP) quantum channel $Φ$, applied an integer number $n$ of times, while physical data are probabilities $p_n^{\mathbf A}(x|ρ)$ associated with states $ρ$ and observables $\mathbf A$ having measurements results $x$. We define exceptional channels through nontrivial Jordan chains of $Φ$ and show that a Jordan block of order $m$ generates discrete polynomial-exponential terms with maximal degree $m-1$. This places the physics of exceptional points in contact with what can be directly measured in experiments.

items.title_en: Encoding Matters: A Qubit-Efficient Reformulation for Quantum Resilient Routing
items.abstract_en: Qubits are powerful computational resources because each additional qubit doubles the size of the accessible state space. This expressive power comes at a cost: adding qubits also increases circuit size, constraint overhead, and exposure to hardware noise. These limitations are especially critical for near-term quantum computers, making the number of qubits required to formulate a problem a central practical concern. In this work, we present a method for efficiently mapping logistics and routing problems onto qubits through structure-aware encoding reduction. We demonstrate the method on a benchmark problem of latency-resilient routing under dual-link failures. For this benchmark, the reduced formulation substantially lowers both the qubit count and the compiled circuit complexity while preserving the original optimization task. By running the reduced model on the same trapped-ion quantum computer as the benchmark, we obtain a 100X improvement in the success probability. This finding shows how careful problem formulation can make current quantum hardware substantially more effective for practical optimization.

items.title_en: Genuine multipartite nonlocality detection in graph states
items.abstract_en: Experimental detection of multipartite Bell nonlocality faces many challenges. The increase in the size of the system demands a higher fidelity of state preparation, a higher detection efficiency, and a larger number of correlators that need to be estimated. These issues are even more pronounced if one wishes to detect a more restrictive variant of Bell nonlocality called genuine multipartite nonlocality (GMNL). In this work, we introduce two classes of multipartite Bell inequalities that are capable of detecting GMNL correlations and address different experimental hurdles in GMNL detection. The first class consists of the number of correlators that scales linearly with the number of parties. The second class increases the number of correlators and, in return, provides higher noise robustness of GMNL detection. Both classes of inequalities are constructed to detect GMNL in graph states, and in fact both can be used for self-testing of graph states and the performed measurements.

items.title_en: Entanglement Catalysis Beyond the Asymptotic Rate
items.abstract_en: Quantum entanglement is a fundamental resource in quantum information science, commonly consumed to perform tasks like quantum teleportation and quantum key distribution. Entanglement concentration converts partially entangled pure states into nearly perfect Bell pairs. While its efficiency is well understood in the asymptotic limit, practical protocols must operate with finite systems. In this finite regime, and at the low error levels relevant in practice, performance is penalized by corrections that reduce the achievable yield. We investigate whether this fundamental finite-size penalty can be mitigated by an entanglement catalyst: an auxiliary state that aids the transformation but is returned exactly and uncorrupted. Although such a catalyst cannot increase the leading-order asymptotic yield, we show that it fundamentally alters the finite-size scaling. For every bipartite pure state with nonuniform Schmidt coefficients, we exactly determine the optimal second-order correction to the yield and show that catalysis completely overcomes this finite-size penalty.

items.title_en: Decoder- and Noise-Aware Optimization Framework for Clifford-Deformed Quantum Error-Correcting Codes
items.abstract_en: Practical fault-tolerant quantum computing requires qubit-efficient quantum error correction (QEC). Clifford deformations (CDs) modify the stabilizers of a QEC code to lower its logical error rate at no additional resource cost. However, the number of possible CDs grows exponentially with the number of qubits, making exhaustive search infeasible beyond small codes. In this work, we further show that under circuit level noise the optimal CD depends strongly on both the noise model and decoder. To make systematic CD optimization possible, we introduce Evolution-Based Best-arm Identification (EBBI), a shot-efficient search algorithm that treats the circuit, noise model and decoder as a black box. We benchmark EBBI's performance on the rotated surface code, under two strongly $Z$-biased circuit-level noise models with the PyMatching decoder. At distance 3, EBBI finds the optimal CD using up to $\sim 1100\times$ fewer shots than random search. At distance 5, when run at the target error rate, the median EBBI run converges to the CDs we believe to be optimal, while random search never converges. Under a $Z$-biased SI1000-like noise model, EBBI discovers a new CD, the B-XZZX code, which we generalized to larger distances. It differs from XZZX on only a fraction $\mathcal{O}(d^{-1})$ of the qubits at code distance $d$, yet its relative advantage grows from $\approx 5\%$ at $d = 3$ to $\approx 12\%$ at $d = 11$. We thus show that the B-XZZX pattern found by EBBI can be systematically scaled to larger code distances. Our work represents a first step towards scalable CD optimization for general QEC codes.

items.title_en: Correlation-Based Measurement of Entanglement in Rank-2 Mixed States
items.abstract_en: We study correlation-based entanglement evaluation in rank-2 mixed states of two- and multi-qubit systems. The relevant two-dimensional subspace is treated as a logical qubit embedded in the physical Hilbert space, and factorizable realizations of its logical Pauli operators are classified. For two qubits, this yields nontrivial canonical encodings related by local Clifford transformations. The relation between logical and physical Bloch vectors admits a geometric interpretation as a transversely deformed Bloch sphere, leading to closed-form expressions for two-qubit concurrence and generalized concurrence across $N$-qubit bipartitions. The entanglement scaling factor is obtained directly from complementary-subsystem correlations, without prior calibration of state-preparation parameters. Noisy simulations using the IBM Quantum FakeKingston backend model, with readout-error mitigation and zero-noise extrapolation, confirm the analytical results up to $N=10$ qubits. The protocol therefore enables entanglement estimation from only a small number of measurement settings for this class of rank-2 logical states.

items.title_en: Holographic Krylov complexity in confining backgrounds: particle, string, and frames
items.abstract_en: We investigate holographic Krylov complexity in bottom-up holographic QCD models describing the confined phase, using the recently proposed correspondence between the growth rate of Krylov complexity and the proper radial momentum of probes, such as particles and strings, falling in the bulk spacetime. As representative confining backgrounds, we consider two horizonless geometries, namely the dilaton-deformed AdS-soliton and the deformed thermal-AdS spacetime, both arising as solutions of an Einstein-dilaton gravity system. We find that the Krylov complexity associated with a massive particle exhibits qualitatively distinct behavior in these two backgrounds when analyzed in the Einstein frame. In the deformed AdS-soliton geometry, the complexity undergoes periodic oscillations, with both the oscillation period and amplitude depending on the parameters of the model. In contrast, in the deformed thermal-AdS geometry, the complexity grows exponentially at late times and does not display oscillatory behavior. We then investigate string dynamics in the string frame and find that the Krylov complexity exhibits oscillatory behavior in both confining backgrounds. This behavior is traced to the emergence of an additional turning point in the deep infrared of the string-frame geometry. Motivated by this observation, we further analyze massive-particle dynamics in the string frame, where we find qualitatively similar behavior in the two confining backgrounds. Our results demonstrate that the Krylov complexity of confined holographic systems depends sensitively on the choice of probe and frame, while also revealing a closer correspondence between the two confining geometries in the string-frame description.

items.title_en: Aubry-André transition in photonic time quasicrystals
items.abstract_en: In one dimension, Anderson localization by a disordered potential sets in at any strength, whereas localization by a quasiperiodic potential in the Aubry-André model occurs through a transition at a critical strength. Disordered photonic time crystals exhibit a temporal counterpart of this Anderson localization, in which light, instead of decaying in space, stops propagating and grows in time. Whether a counterpart of the Aubry-André transition exists in photonic time quasicrystals remains an open question. Here we show that it does, and that the transition occurs at mobility edges in momentum rather than in energy. These edges arise even under impulsive modulation, where the field obeys the self-dual almost-Mathieu equation exactly, and for general analytic modulations Avila's global theory reveals the condition under which they form. The Aubry-André transition thus extends from spatial lattices to the time domain, where it sorts light by wave number into components that propagate and components that stop and grow.

items.title_en: UV Fluorescence Sensing of Medical-Chemical-and- Biological Analytes by an AlGaN/Si-on-Sapphire Optoelectronic Chip
items.title_zh: 基于AlGaN/蓝宝石上硅光电子芯片的医学、化学与生物分析物紫外荧光传感
items.abstract_en: This paper proposes and analyzes a compact fluorescence-photometer lab-on-a-chip that is simpler than a fluorescence spectrometer, and that does not require spectrum reconstruction by a computer. An on-chip AlGaN VCSEL lasing at 280 nm, or at 310 nm, pumps an on-chip sample in the form of liquid or solid or tissue, thereby exciting signature fluorescence in the 300 to 540 nm wavelength range. This emission signal is detected and read out by an on-chip UV-enhanced Silicon photodiode. The 2 cm x 5 cm chip consists of C-plane (0001) Sapphire, and no lenses, prisms, or mirrors are utilized in the photometer. The chip is opto-electronic and features co-packaged electronics using tiny electronic chiplets that are bonded to the sapphire. These consist of an LD driver and transimpedance amplifier for the UV photonics, together with ASICs, ADC, microcontroller, micro-battery and RF-wireless or Ethernet chiplets. The mission of this self-contained cost-effective chip is sensing targeted medical-chemical-biological (MCB) agents in a local or network setting. Eight significant MCB applications are detailed here.

items.title_en: Construction of isoscattering non-isospectral quantum graphs using the concept of a germ graph
items.abstract_en: The recently developed concept of germ graphs (P. Kurasov {\it et al.}, Phys. Rev. Research {\bf 7}, L022071 (2025)) is employed to construct families of isocattering, non-isospectral graphs that exhibit dissipation. More specifically, a new pair of isoscattering non-isospectral graphs is constructed by connecting the existing isoscattering non-isospectral graphs, so called attachments, to the different contact vertices of the germ graph. The existing isoscattering non-isospectral graphs contained a two-loop graph labelled $Γ_{A2}$ and a three-loop graph labelled $Γ_{A3}$. These graphs have an equal total metric length, but different topologies. The resulting graphs $Γ_3$ and $Γ_4$ are verified as non-isospectral using their Euler characteristics, while their isoscattering properties are investigated by calculating the one-port scattering matrices numerically.

items.title_en: Finite Quantum Engineering Thermodynamics
items.abstract_en: A useful thermodynamic model predicts what a device will do without tracking its full microscopic state. For a finite quantum working medium, the difficult question is which quantities should actually be measured. We develop a task-based method that keeps exact energy accounting separate from calibrated macroscopic prediction. Operator geometry identifies what a measured record determines and bounds what remains uncertain. We then compare direct measurements of dynamical observables with earlier measurements of the same coarse record, selecting the representation together with its measurement cost. A Bose--Hubbard example yields a compact response table tested over a continuous operating region and on unseen microscopic trajectories. A driven Ising chain shows why history is not always the cheaper choice. The result is a way to turn detailed quantum dynamics into a small, reusable, and explicitly qualified thermodynamic description.

items.title_en: Harmonic analysis and circuit approximation of Sobolev functions on quantum input spaces
items.abstract_en: We derive approximation rates for Sobolev functions defined on the complex unit sphere and complex projective space, representing quantum states, and on the special and projective unitary groups, representing quantum unitary operations. By using harmonic analysis on compact groups and compact homogeneous spaces, we characterize the corresponding Peter--Weyl decompositions and Sobolev spaces via irreducible representations and the Laplace--Beltrami operator. Combining spectral truncation with finite-depth quantum-circuit approximation, invoking the Solovay--Kitaev theorem, we establish quantitative rates that separate the spectral truncation error from the circuit approximation error.

items.title_en: Spectral-control-assisted Kerr-lens mode-locking in a Tm:Y2O3 ceramic laser
items.abstract_en: We report a soft-aperture Kerr-lens mode-locked Tm:Y2O3 ceramic laser stabilized by suppressing wavelength competition under high population-inversion conditions. The laser delivers an average output power of 0.5 W with a pulse duration of 112 fs at a repetition rate of 90 MHz and a central wavelength of 2.08 um. Further optimization for shorter pulses yields a pulse duration of 107 fs, through with a reduced output power of 0.22 W. These results demonstrate that spectral-control is an effective approach for achieving stable mode-locking in such laser with strong spectral competition.

items.title_en: Predicting Nanofabrication Variance: A Conditional Diffusion Model
items.title_zh: 预测纳米制造方差：一种条件扩散模型
items.abstract_en: Micro- and nanostructures fabricated by focused ion beam (FIB) milling invariably deviate from input designs due to systematic and stochastic effects such as ablation-rate fluctuations, and redeposition. As such, nominally identical iterations of a given process yield a distribution of non-identical fabrication outcomes, leading to variations in the physical (optical, mechanical) properties of fabricated structures. Existing models of the milling process typically predict a single deterministic fabrication result, neglecting this variability. Here we present a conditional diffusion model that learns the statistical distribution of process outcomes conditioned on input design, enabling it to predict a realistic distribution of possible output sample structures. These predictions accurately reproduce edge morphology, linewidth variations, and defect probabilities observed in fabricated samples, enabling statistical analysis of milling performance and the identification of dominant structural and process parameter-dependent deformation modes. The work establishes a probabilistic modelling framework for fabrication variability analysis and fabrication-aware design optimization.

items.title_en: VN-GraphGG: von Neumann--Mullins--based graph grain growth simulation
items.title_zh: VN-GraphGG：基于von Neumann–Mullins的图晶粒生长模拟
items.abstract_en: Efficient simulations of grain growth are essential for investigating the process-structure-property relationships in polycrystalline materials. We introduce a two-dimensional von Neumann-Mullins-based graph grain growth simulation (VN-GraphGG), which couples the grain-scale kinetics with microstructure reconstruction. The polycrystalline microstructure is represented as a graph with grain and junction nodes. The grain-area evolution on the grain graph is governed by the von Neumann--Mullins (VN) law, while a graph neural network is trained to reconstruct the microstructure from the graph. This separation allows kinetic coefficients to be varied without retraining the neural reconstruction model. Topological changes during grain growth such as disappearance of grains and changes in neighbor relations are handled straightforwardly through reconstruction and postprocessing. Simulations demonstrate accurate predictions of VN kinetics and coarsening statistics, and significant speedup over the phase-field simulations. The proposed method provides a foundation for efficient grain growth simulation based on grain-scale kinetics, opening the way to incorporate a broader range of physical mechanisms. An application example is presented for abnormal grain growth, in which kinetic heterogeneity significantly influences the grain microstructure evolution.

items.title_en: Modelling Josephson Junctions with Boundary Conditions: Towards High-Fidelity Models for Superconducting Qubits
items.abstract_en: Josephson junctions are the central nonlinear element of superconducting qubits, yet their standard description is reached through a chain of approximations. We propose a purely quantum-mechanical model of the junction, formulated directly in Hilbert space: a charged particle moves on a one-dimensional loop, and the junction is a point at which the wave function obeys self-adjoint boundary conditions, labelled by a coupling strength $λ$, which controls the transparency of the junction, and a phase jump $δ$, which plays the role of the superconducting phase difference. For a loop with a single junction we solve the spectral problem and show that the ground-state momentum expectation, identified with the supercurrent, factorises exactly as $\langle\hat{p}_0\rangle = I_c(δ,λ)\sinδ$. For opaque junctions $I_c$ becomes independent of $δ$ and the first Josephson relation $I=I_c\sinδ$ is recovered; for strongly attractive coupling, where the ground state is bound to the junction, the $\sinδ$ law is also recovered, but with an exponentially suppressed amplitude. For more transparent junctions, however, the model \emph{predicts} deviations from the pure $\sinδ$ law: $I_c$ acquires a dependence on $δ$ already at order $λ^{-2}$, compatible with the higher Josephson harmonics recently found necessary to describe superconducting qubit spectra, and a fully transparent contact yields a current linear in $δ$. When the phase varies in time, a gauge transformation shows that the voltage drop across the junction is proportional to $\dotδ$, so that the second Josephson relation emerges without being imposed. The boundary-condition approach thus reproduces both Josephson relations from first principles and predicts corrections to them, offering a route towards higher-fidelity models of superconducting qubits.

items.title_en: Localization Landscapes based on the Green's Matrix of Non-Hermitian Optical Scattering Systems
items.abstract_en: The Filoche--Mayboroda (FM) localization landscape predicts where the spatially localized modes of a self-adjoint elliptic operator reside without diagonalizing it, but the construction fails for the complex, non-normal Green's matrix G of an open scattering array of electric dipoles. We propose three real-valued, positive landscapes built from the Feinberg--Zee hermitization of G: a regularised Gramian inverse (Gram), the diagonal Schur block that carries the Metz--Neri--Rogers spectral density (SY), and the full hermitized inverse contracted against a polarization-isotropic source pair (Herm). The three form a progression from spectrum-blind to fully hermitisation-faithful, agree in the limit $z\to 0$, and diverge where it matters: at nonzero spectral shift SY resolves modes that Gram collapses, and Herm resolves modes that SY collapses. We demonstrate the progression on random and deterministic aperiodic scattering arrays with a wide range of structural correlations, extend to the vectorial case of transverse electric polarization (TE), and provide rigorous justifications along with mathematical proofs and a complete numerical recipe in the appendices and in the supplementary material.

items.title_en: Quantitative Eshelby stability: local and finite-shape theory through AI-assisted mechanics
items.title_zh: 定量Eshelby稳定性：通过AI辅助力学的局域与有限形状理论
items.abstract_en: How can human researchers use artificial intelligence (AI) to make progress on difficult mechanics problems while retaining control of physical significance, mathematical rigor, and validation? We explore this opportunity through a quantitative stability problem rooted in the Eshelby conjecture. For a uniform dilatational eigenstrain in a homogeneous isotropic solid, we establish a nonlinear two-sided relation between whole-interior strain heterogeneity and a geometry-only distance from the ellipsoid family, with half-order Sobolev scaling that captures morphological length scale. We then develop a complementary finite-shape theory: ellipsoidal subtraction yields an exact residual-field budget from which systematically convergent upper and lower bounds are obtained for a prescribed geometry. Applied to protruded, indented, and necked inclusions, the bounds agree with independent displacement-based finite-element calculations. The study also documents a human-led, AI-assisted research process in which researchers select consequential problems, shape targets, audit arguments, require independent checks, and interpret mechanics, while AI broadens analytical exploration and supports computation. This experience also led us to develop Open Problems in Mechanics, a versioned community-facing map that makes selected mechanics questions, their known/open boundaries, and criteria for progress explicit.

items.title_en: Quantum extreme learning for forecasting experimental chaotic electronic circuits
items.abstract_en: Quantum reservoir computing and its special case, quantum extreme learning, are powerful tools for predicting classical discrete time-series with quantum devices. Forecasting continuous signals, however, requires careful discretization as oversampling artificially boosts short-term accuracy but fails over realistic intervals, while undersampling captures too few features and yields poor predictions. Here, we experimentally generate four continuous time-series signals from a chaotic electronic circuit for forecasting with quantum extreme learning. Since simplified circuit models do not fully capture real behaviour, it is unclear whether algorithms that predict simulated time-series also work for experimental signals. We address discretization via two approaches: (i) sampling local peaks/troughs; and (ii) uniform sampling at the autocorrelation timescale. The former captures resonant behaviour, while the latter fully captures chaotic features as well as allowing the reconstruction of chaotic attractors. Our algorithm achieves high forecasting accuracy for both simulated and experimental signals, demonstrating its power for continuous signal processing on near-term quantum simulators, and remains robust against moderate decoherence.

items.title_en: Pulse-by-pulse imaging of reversible, collective reshaping in laser-excited gold nanorods
items.title_zh: 激光激发金纳米棒中可逆集体重塑的逐脉冲成像
items.abstract_en: Nanomaterial properties are governed by atomic structure, and driving structural changes on demand could enable materials with programmable properties. Pulsed light is the most controllable route: wavelength, fluence, polarization and pulse timing can each be tuned to inject energy with nanometre and picosecond precision and mould atomic positions. Yet the spatiotemporal dynamics of these transformations have remained hidden, inferred only from before-and-after snapshots. Here we track gold nanorods in a transmission electron microscope under pulsed optical excitation, quantifying the structural transition frame by frame. The rods enter an unexpectedly dynamic regime: material redistributes within and between particles, twin boundaries nucleate and propagate, rods hundreds of nanometres apart reshape in concert, and individual rods almost vanish before recovering their original shape, indicating a structural memory. Driving and following these transformations with pulse-synchronized in situ electron microscopy could turn light-induced reshaping into a tool for setting structure, and consequently properties, on demand.

items.title_en: Bottom-Up Surface-Enhanced Raman Scattering for the Detection of Micro-Objects and Globular Analytes
items.title_zh: 自下而上的表面增强拉曼散射用于微物体与球状分析物的检测
items.abstract_en: Surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) is typically achieved by depositing the analyte on a metal or semiconductor substrate. We propose a bottom-up approach, enabling SERS by depositing a metal on the surface of the object being studied. A Mie-theory analysis of electric-field enhancement in dielectric core-shell particles is presented. A correlative approach combining SERS, atomic force microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy is employed to model the conditions required for sensitive SERS detection and spectral analysis of polystyrene microspheres (PMSs) as models of globular and vesicle-like objects. Based on these findings, we propose a SERS-active system that provides strong signal enhancement (up to four orders of magnitude for a single globular object) while maintaining spectral fidelity, where PMSs act both as model analytes and as integral components of a metal-dielectric resonator.

items.title_en: Wideband microwave resonator for NV center vector magnetometry
items.abstract_en: The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) color center in diamond has found applications in magnetometry across various geometrical scales. In particular, vector magnetometry using hand-held devices with low power consumption is of interest for mobile and geological applications. However, such a device requires efficient driving of the four different orientations of the NV center, thus placing demands on a broadband microwave resonator that provides a uniform and highly insensitive microwave magnetic field at the resonance frequencies of the NV centers. Here, we propose a unique planar resonator design that enables efficient driving of all four orientations of NV color centers over a 100 MHz range with only 0.5 W of microwave input power and 250 mW of laser power, allowing vector magnetic field measurements. Using the planar resonator to drive NV centers in diamond, a compact vector magnetometer was fabricated and experimentally studied. The sensitivity of the device is about \[{1.2\text{ nT}}/{\sqrt{\text{Hz}}}\;\]. While this is not a record sensitivity for diamond-based magnetometers, this device occupies its own niche as a compact hand-held magnetometer.

items.title_en: System-Design Optimization of a Single-Transmitter, Single-Fiber QKD-based ITS Communication Link
items.abstract_en: Deploying QKD-based secure communication at scale requires reducing duplicated optical hardware while preserving the rate of protected user data. Earlier studies established the physical feasibility of carrying CV-QKD and classical signals over shared infrastructure, motivating a quantitative comparison between optical hardware savings and the OTP-encrypted rate. We perform this comparison by defining the secure communication rate (SCR) as the rate jointly supported by secret-key generation and classical transport, and using it to optimize a shared discrete-modulation CV-QKD link. The model combines a binomial 64-QAM security bound with a trusted receiver, protocol traffic, spectral leakage - optical power leaking into the quantum receive band - and Raman scattering. At 25 km, the asymptotic model gives an optimized SCR of 12.079 Mbps, compared with 12.095 Mbps for a separated-link reference, while reducing the transmitter and fiber counts from two to one each in the modeled direction. Increasing channel separation suppresses spectral leakage, but the resulting SCR gain diminishes once receiver bandwidth limits the rate. Under the adopted receiver-noise law, increasing the bandwidth budget from 350 to 750 MHz raises the projected 25-km SCR to 24.535 Mbps despite higher trusted electronic noise. For the studied metropolitan link, sharing saves optical resources with little rate loss, while receiver-bandwidth improvements provide greater benefit than further spectral separation. Together, these results suggest an integration path: share the transmitter and fiber, limit unwanted classical power in the quantum receive band, and increase usable receiver bandwidth where the noise budget permits.

items.title_en: Second quantization and compactness of induced Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups
items.abstract_en: We characterize compactness of the Hilbert-Schmidt semigroups induced by finite-mode Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups with a faithful normal invariant state. A unitary second-quantization representation for every $ s $-embedding shows that compactness at one positive time, compact resolvent, drift stability, and uniqueness of the normal invariant state are equivalent. These conditions imply immediate trace-class membership for all embeddings. We derive exact trace-norm and Hilbert--Schmidt norm formulas, an embedding-independent trace identity, and the generator spectrum with algebraic multiplicities. Examples show that compactness does not require the existence of a spectral gap and that a spectral gap need not imply compactness when the invariant state is not unique.

items.title_en: A General Method for Extending Isoscattering Non-Isospectral Quantum Graphs
items.abstract_en: The present paper sets out a general method for extending the isoscattering, non-isospectral quantum graphs. The methodology is illustrated by considering two graphs, denoted by $Γ_1$ and $Γ_2$, which have the same total metric length but different topologies. It is demonstrated that, despite the fact that their scattering matrices are identical, their eigenvalues, denoted by $k_n$, and Euler characteristics differ from one another. The next step in the process is to extend both graphs by affixing the same star graph to each of them. Utilising the Titchmarsh-Weyl M-function formalism, it is proven that the newly constructed, extended graphs are also isoscattering and non-isospectral.

items.title_en: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
items.title_zh: AgentSWE：编码智能体能否构建你真正想要的智能体？
items.abstract_en: As the production of software passes into the hands of software itself, coding agents are increasingly commissioned to build agents fitted to their users' own workflows. This delegation carries a quiet assumption, that the delivered agent will faithfully serve the requirement it was built for, rather than merely appear to. No existing benchmark tests that assumption. We introduce AgentSWE, a benchmark for agent software engineering spanning three stages of the agent development lifecycle: Creation of a complete agent from a natural-language requirement, Editing of production agent codebases, and Optimization toward a measurable target. Each of its 25 tasks is framed as a commission rather than an exam: the builder iterates against a handful of illustrative cases, while acceptance exercises the frozen submission on held-out cases designed to span the full requirement, grading behavior against requirement-derived rubrics under hard pass/fail gates or, for Optimization, against the source benchmark's own objective. Evaluating a range of coding agents across models and harnesses, we find that none comes close to delivering what a requirement asks for: the gap between what a builder demonstrates and what it delivers is the norm, not the corner case. An accompanying empirical analysis of the failure trajectories identifies recurring failure modes, among them overfitting to the visible cases, hollow runtimes behind code that looks complete, and unsupported claims of completion, each a signal by which coding agents can learn to build the agents they are asked for.
items.abstract_zh: 随着软件生产逐渐交由软件自身完成，编码智能体越来越多地被委托去构建贴合用户自身工作流的智能体。这种委托暗含一个前提：交付的智能体应忠实服务于其被构建的目的，而非只是看起来如此；但目前尚无基准检验这一假设。我们提出AgentSWE，一个覆盖智能体开发生命周期三阶段的基准：依据自然语言需求创建完整智能体、编辑生产级智能体代码库、以及朝可量化目标优化。其25个任务均以“委托”而非“考试”的形式设定：构建者针对少量示例迭代，验收阶段则在冻结的提交上使用覆盖完整需求的留出案例，按需求衍生的评分标准以硬性通过/失败门槛评分，优化任务则采用源基准自身的目标。对多种模型与框架下的编码智能体评测显示，没有一个能接近需求所要求的结果，演示与交付之间的差距是常态而非例外。对失败轨迹的实证分析识别出若干反复出现的失败模式，如对可见案例过拟合、代码看似完整却运行空洞、以及无依据的完成声明。
items.highlight_zh: 首个基准揭示智能体造智能体普遍不达标，交付与需求差距是常态
items.digest_zh:
「研究了什么问题」：如今人们常让编码智能体去“造智能体”——用户给出需求，智能体交付一个能用的agent。这一过程默认交付物真的满足需求；但作者指出，没有任何基准测试验证过这个默认假设，智能体很可能只是“看起来像”而非“确实做到”。
「用了什么方法」：作者提出AgentSWE基准，覆盖智能体开发生命周期的三个阶段：①从自然语言需求创建完整智能体；②编辑生产级智能体代码库；③朝可量化目标优化。共25个任务，每个都按“委托”而非“考试”设计：构建者只能看到少量示例并据此迭代，验收时则把提交冻结，用覆盖完整需求的留出案例来考；评分依据从需求推导出的评分标准，采用硬性通过/失败门槛；优化类任务直接看源基准的目标指标。
「有什么结果」：他们评测了不同模型与框架下的多种编码智能体，没有一个接近满足需求；“演示能过、交付过不了”是普遍现象而非个别情况。作者还分析失败轨迹，归纳出反复出现的失败模式：对可见示例过拟合、代码看似完整但运行时是空壳，以及在无依据的情况下声称已完成。
「为何重要」：它把“智能体造智能体”这一日益普遍的委托行为的隐患摆上台面，并提供了可复现的评测方式。对这些失败模式的识别，也为编码智能体的改进指明方向——不仅要会写代码，还要学会判断自己是否真的完成了需求。

items.title_en: Constructive Bounds for the Topological Expressivity of Neural Networks
items.title_zh: 神经网络拓扑表达力的构造性界
items.abstract_en: The expressivity of a neural network $Φ$ describes the class of functions that a network can express. The term topological expressivity refers to a family of measures particularly suited to understand binary classification and is often formulated in terms of the Betti numbers of a decision boundary $β(Φ^{-1}(0))$. Despite its popularity, this measure is not as useful for regression and other problems that do not involve a decision boundary. Instead, we propose to study topological expressivity in terms of the Betti numbers of the output of a neural network $β(Φ(X))$. We formally prove that a ReLU network with architecture $(d,\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d } β_k(3k+2),\sum\limits_{k=1}^{d}β_k(k+1))$ can express spaces homotopy equivalent to wedge sums of spheres with arbitrary Betti numbers. This gives upper bounds for any arbitrary connected ($β_0=1$) sequence of Betti numbers, but by constructing spaces homotopy equivalent to products of $N$ spheres of dimension $d_1,...,d_N$ we achieve much better bounds $(\sum\limits_{n=1} d_n, 3\sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + 2N, \sum\limits_{n=1}\limits^N d_n + N) $ for Betti numbers given by $\prod_n (1+x^{d_n})$. Finally we conjecture a much stronger tight bound which gives the architectural bound $(d,d+1,d+1)$ for a space homeomorphic to the sphere.
items.abstract_zh: 神经网络的表达力描述其能表达的函数类别。拓扑表达力指一类特别适合理解二分类的度量，通常以决策边界Φ⁻¹(0)的Betti数β(Φ⁻¹(0))表述；但该度量对回归等不涉及决策边界的问题并不适用。为此，我们提出以神经网络输出Φ(X)的Betti数β(Φ(X))来研究拓扑表达力。我们证明，架构为 (d, Σ_{k=1}^d β_k(3k+2), Σ_{k=1}^d β_k(k+1)) 的ReLU网络可表达同伦等价于任意Betti数球面楔和的空间，从而给出任意连通（β₀=1）Betti数序列的上界；进一步通过构造同伦等价于N个维度为d₁,…,d_N的球面之积的空间，对由∏_n(1+x^{d_n})给出的Betti数得到更好的界 (Σd_n, 3Σd_n+2N, Σd_n+N)。最后我们猜想一个更强的紧界：对同胚于球面的空间，架构界为 (d, d+1, d+1)。
items.highlight_zh: 改用输出Betti数刻画表达力，给出ReLU网络的构造性拓扑上界
items.digest_zh:
「研究了什么问题」：神经网络的“表达力”指它能表达哪些函数。常用的“拓扑表达力”用决策边界的Betti数来衡量，适合理解二分类；但对回归等没有决策边界的问题就用不上这个度量。作者想换一个更通用的刻画方式。
「用了什么方法」：作者提出改看网络输出Φ(X)的Betti数，即网络输出集合本身的拓扑形状，而不是只看零水平集。Betti数β_k统计的是k维“洞”的个数：β₀是连通分量数，β₁是环数，依此类推；这样度量的对象不再局限于分类边界。基于此，作者用构造性方法直接造出能实现特定拓扑的网络，从而得到所需的宽度与深度。
「有什么结果」：他们证明，若一个ReLU网络的架构为 (d, Σβ_k(3k+2), Σβ_k(k+1))，它就能表达与任意Betti数球面楔和同伦等价的空间，给出任意连通（β₀=1）Betti数序列的上界。进一步，通过构造同伦等价于N个球面之积的空间（维度d₁,…,d_N），对由∏(1+x^{d_n})给出的Betti数得到更紧的界 (Σd_n, 3Σd_n+2N, Σd_n+N)。最后他们猜想一个更强的紧界：对同胚于球面的空间，架构界可低至 (d, d+1, d+1)。
「为何重要」：这为“网络要多大才能表达某种拓扑形状”提供了可计算的构造性上界，把拓扑表达力从分类专用工具推广到更一般的问题，也让网络宽度与深度的需求有了基于拓扑的定量刻画。

items.title_en: AI Models Can Provably Hide Arbitrary Capabilities
items.title_zh: AI 模型可证明地隐藏任意能力
items.abstract_en: Capability evaluations aim to surface dangerous model behaviors before deployment, but their reliability depends on the assumption that hidden capabilities can be elicited. We show this assumption does not hold under adversarial conditions by constructing backdoor attacks that embed encrypted neural networks within host model weights, decrypting and executing them only upon receiving a secret trigger. Using digital lockers, these hidden circuits remain provably hard to elicit and interpret under cryptographic assumptions, even given full access to model weights, extending prior work from hiding fixed strings to arbitrary computations. We implement our proof of concept constructions in PyTorch and evaluate elicitation through fine-tuning, weight noising, gradient-based trigger search, and latent adversarial training on a small chemical reaction prediction task - a proxy for CBRN-relevant capabilities. Our results demonstrate resistance to these methods and, together with our cryptographic guarantees, reveal a limit of elicitation-based capability audits. We release our models to support the improvement of defenses.
items.abstract_zh: 能力评估旨在部署前发现危险的模型行为，但其可靠性依赖一个假设：隐藏能力可以被诱发出来。我们证明该假设在对抗条件下不成立：通过后门攻击把加密的神经网络嵌入宿主模型权重中，仅在收到秘密触发信号时才解密并执行。借助数字储物柜（digital lockers），这些隐藏电路在密码学假设下可证明难以被诱发和解释，即使拥有全部模型权重，从而把此前隐藏固定字符串的工作扩展到任意计算。我们在 PyTorch 中实现概念验证，并在小型化学反应预测任务（CBRN 相关能力的代理）上，用微调、权重加噪、基于梯度的触发器搜索和潜空间对抗训练评估诱发效果，结果显示这些方法均难以奏效，揭示了基于诱发的模型能力审计的局限。
items.highlight_zh: 后门加密网络可证明地隐藏任意能力，诱发式审计失效
items.digest_zh:
研究了什么问题：当前很多 AI 安全评估都基于一个假设——模型如果藏有危险能力，只要反复“诱发”（诱导调用）就能暴露。本文质疑这个假设是否成立。
用了什么方法：作者用后门攻击的方式，把一个完整的加密神经网络“藏”进宿主模型的权重里，只有收到特定秘密触发器时才解密并运行这段隐藏网络。他们借用密码学中的 digital locker（数字储物柜），使隐藏电路在相应密码学假设下可证明难以被诱发或解释，即使攻击者拿到全部权重。此前类似工作只能隐藏固定字符串，本文把它扩展到任意计算，并用 PyTorch 做了概念验证。
有什么结果：他们在一个小规模化学反应预测任务（作为 CBRN 相关能力的代理）上评估诱发，尝试了微调、权重加噪、梯度式触发器搜索、潜空间对抗训练等方法，结果显示隐藏能力对这些手段都有抵抗性；再结合密码学保证，说明可以做到“可证明地”难以提取。
为何重要：能力评估是模型部署前的安全闸门，本文表明基于诱发的审计存在原理性上限，模型可能带着评估看不到的能力通过检查。作者公开模型以帮助改进防御。

items.title_en: KL Before and After Mixing: A Round-Complexity Separation in Parallel Sampling
items.title_zh: 混合前后的 KL：并行采样中的轮复杂度分离
items.abstract_en: A parallel sampler can choose at random which coordinates to generate together. For a target $p$ and the output law $q_U$ of a schedule $U$ drawn afresh for each output, we compare the schedule-averaged divergence $\mathbb{E}_U D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|q_U)$ with the output-law divergence $D_{\mathrm{KL}}(p\|\mathbb{E}_U q_U)$, in nats. Rounds commit independent draws from exact conditional marginals frozen at the round's start, each output's schedule is drawn before sampling from a finite mixture of schedules, and every scheduled round is charged. For the uniform distribution on binary strings of even length $n$ with $n/2$ ones, the least expected number of rounds at a fixed tolerance $\varepsilon>0$ is $Θ_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ under the first criterion but $(e^{-\varepsilon}+o(1))\log_2\ln n$ under the second, and the double-logarithmic order is attainable with the same round count on every run. For this target, a count-state recursion gives the exact least output divergence at every round cap over all causal randomized policies. The separation extends to weighted fixed-count targets with bounded weight ratios and quota fractions bounded away from zero and one, without permutation symmetry, and to the full-support Beta$(1,1)$--Bernoulli target, where the sharp expected cost under the output-law criterion is $(e^{-\varepsilon}/2+o(1))\log_2\log_2n$, attained with rare $n$-round runs. Prior work implies the order of the schedule-averaged cost on the balanced target and its $O_\varepsilon((\log n)^2)$ upper bounds on both extensions.

items.title_en: Goal-Oriented Bundle Management and Flow Control for Deep-Space Communications via Reinforcement Learning
items.title_zh: 基于强化学习的面向目标的深空通信束管理与流量控制
items.abstract_en: Deep-space communications operate under intermittent connectivity, long propagation delays, and relay storage constraints. In such networks, the Bundle Protocol enables store-carry-forward communication, requiring relay nodes to manage limited storage and scarce contact opportunities. Relay-side scheduling and dropping decisions are inherently goal-oriented: transmission resources should be allocated to bundles most valuable to downstream mission objectives. Conventional schedulers, such as FIFO, do not explicitly optimize task utility and may provide unfair service across heterogeneous planetary sources. This paper presents a closed-loop modeling and learning framework for relay-side bundle and flow management in a contact-driven deep-space network, where lunar and Martian updates are forwarded through a shared-buffer relay to Earth. We quantify destination-side information freshness using excess age $Δ_i^e(t)=[Δ_i(t)-d_i(t)]^+$, where $Δ_i(t)$ denotes the Age of Information of source $i$ and $d_i(t)$ is a source-dependent delay baseline. Based on this metric, we define a goal-oriented loss that supports source-dependent nonlinear penalties, allowing prioritization according to mission relevance. We formulate relay control as a constrained semi-Markov decision process (CSMDP) and solve it using masked Lagrangian Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Feasibility-aware action masking restricts transmissions to bundles that can complete within the remaining contact window. DTNSim simulations indicate improved age-based utility and inter-flow fairness compared with baseline schedulers. The proposed framework jointly optimizes relay-side bundle scheduling, dropping, and flow control under contact-driven dynamics with explicit fairness considerations across heterogeneous sources.

items.title_en: Revisiting Tabular Deep Regression: Objectives and the Limits of Global Early Stopping
items.title_zh: 重新审视表格深度回归：目标与全局早停的局限
items.abstract_en: While deep learning models for tabular data have recently received significant research attention, the choice of objective functions for regression tasks remains an understudied degree of freedom. Several lines of research offer alternatives to the standard Mean Squared Error (MSE), but differences in datasets, backbones, and evaluation protocols make their practical benefits difficult to compare. In this work, we address this gap by performing a systematic re-evaluation of regression objectives across a broad collection of established tabular datasets and multiple neural backbones. Our comparison reveals that many proposed objectives provide limited or inconsistent gains over a properly tuned MSE baseline, while quantile loss yields consistent aggregate improvements over MSE across the tested backbones. We then identify a limitation that remains even with this strong objective: regions with different levels of target noise can reach their best predictive performance at different training epochs. Consequently, a single global early-stopping checkpoint can impose a compromise between uncertainty regions, even when the objective can represent heteroskedastic target distributions. Motivated by this limitation, we introduce a heteroskedasticity-aware extension of quantile loss that uses input-dependent label smoothing as a potential remedy and improves over quantile loss on several backbones. Overall, our results provide a modern empirical picture of regression objectives for tabular deep learning and highlight how differences in optimal stopping times across uncertainty regions can limit the effectiveness of global early stopping. The code is available at https://github.com/yandex-research/tabular-regression.

items.title_en: Hitting-Time Bounds for Asynchronous Q-Learning
items.title_zh: 异步Q-Learning的命中时间界
items.abstract_en: We study the last iterate of standard asynchronous Q-learning from a single trajectory of a finite Markov decision process. The trajectory follows a fixed behavior policy whose state--action chain is irreducible and may be periodic. For discount factor $γ$, write $H=(1-γ)^{-1}$, and let $μ_{\min}$ be the minimum stationary state--action probability and $\mathfrak h_\star$ the largest expected hitting time of the reverse state--action chain. We prove that zero-initialized Q-learning with a constant step size achieves sup-norm error at most $\varepsilon$ with high probability using $\widetilde{O}(H^4/(μ_{\min}\varepsilon^2)+\mathfrak h_\star)$ transitions, for $0<\varepsilon\le1$. The statistical term retains the quartic effective-horizon dependence of standard Q-learning, while initialization cost is additive in $\mathfrak h_\star$. For aperiodic behavior chains, a comparison with mixing time yields a transient term $\widetilde{O}(t_{\mathrm{mix}}/μ_{\min})$. An empirical state--action count rule selects a constant step size for a subsequent training run and attains the same rate without prior knowledge of model parameters, target accuracy, or confidence level. The output is the last training iterate, with both stages included in the sample count. The proof uses two deterministic Bellman envelopes to separate statistical error from fixed-policy initialization error and adapts reverse-time hitting-cost compensation from TD learning to state--action propagation. An exploration lower bound holds for arbitrary predictable step sizes. Together with the existing statistical lower bound and its extension to pilot-selected constant steps, it yields matching mean-square rates up to logarithmic factors on the stated large-sample parameter classes.

items.title_en: Prediction Is Not a Sufficient Memory State
items.title_zh: 预测不是充分的记忆状态
items.abstract_en: A memory that reproduces every current prediction may still have forgotten how to learn from the next observation. We characterize this distinction for exact cumulative learning and attention. For smooth convex residual losses with unrestricted real features and labels, a continuous recurrent state of fixed dimension exists exactly when the loss is polynomial. With ordinary, unweighted observations, degree $D$ requires precisely $r=\binom{d+D}{D}-1$ coordinates; even among histories with one fixed current predictor, exactly $r-d$ coordinates can remain necessary for continuation. Nonpolynomial losses have unbounded requirements on such equal-prediction histories. Bounded scalar logistic examples retain this obstruction after fixing any finite derivative jet. For ridge regression, the hidden evidence is the design matrix: the exact state costs $dp+d(d+1)/2$, versus $dp$ for the predictor. On a well-conditioned zero-prediction family, optimal $B$-bit compression has average one-update error of order $d^{-1}2^{-2B/s_d}$, $s_d=d(d+1)/2$, even with arbitrary randomized codes. Kernel attention gives a second exact closure classification. The results identify what future updates reveal, rather than proposing a new regression algorithm or asserting trained-model gains.

items.title_en: Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization via Zeroth-Order Residual Tracking
items.title_zh: 通过零阶残差跟踪的部分知情随机优化
items.abstract_en: Many optimization problems provide direct access to only part of the gradient, while the remaining component must be inferred from function evaluations. This structure arises in performative prediction, performative reinforcement learning, and bilevel optimization with a black-box lower level. We introduce Partially Informed Stochastic Optimization (PISO), which combines the available gradient component with a running estimate of the residual. By centring each zeroth-order observation on this estimate, PISO makes the variance due to random probing depend on the tracking error rather than the residual's magnitude. This yields a randomized sketch iteration with an explicit contraction mechanism and a principled interpretation of momentum. For smooth nonconvex objectives, we establish convergence guarantees that depend on the residual's variation and initial magnitude, without requiring a uniform bound on the unavailable gradient component. With independently sampled function evaluations and Gaussian or spherical probes, PISO attains leading function-evaluation complexities of \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-6})\) under Lipschitz gradients and \(O(d^{2}\varepsilon^{-5})\) under an additional Lipschitz-Hessian assumption. These rates require only one probe direction, two function samples, and one known-component sample per update. The analysis also quantifies how batching trades observations for fewer deployments. Across five settings, PISO variants improve on the tested baselines with comparable oracle access in three, reach a comparable solution faster in bilevel routing, and perform best among methods without response-model derivatives in performative reinforcement learning.

items.title_en: Finite-Sample Guarantees for Fully Discrete Conditional Diffusion Models
items.title_zh: 全离散条件扩散模型的有限样本保证
items.abstract_en: We establish finite-sample guarantees for conditional diffusion models learned from data and implemented with finitely many denoising steps. Our approach aligns the score-training objective with the sampling grid, allowing statistical estimation and numerical discretization errors to be analyzed together. Under a smooth conditional density model, we derive high-probability bounds on the generated distribution's error and quantify the required number of score evaluations. For every smoothness index $β>0$, a suitable grid yields averaged conditional Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence $\widetilde O_p(n^{-2β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})$ relative to the original target with or without early stopping. Both the full and early-stopped samplers attain average target total-variation (TV) error $\widetilde O_p(n^{-β/(d_x+d_y+2β)})$. Here $n$ is the sample size, $d_x,d_y$ are the data and conditioning dimensions, and errors are averaged over the conditioning variable. The total-variation bound matches the rate established in existing conditional distribution-estimation theory, up to logarithmic factors.

items.title_en: Inference-Time Steering Across Scaffolds and Epitopes for Sample-Efficient De Novo Nanobody Design
items.title_zh: 面向样本高效从头纳米抗体设计的跨支架与表位推理时引导
items.abstract_en: Generative molecular design typically relies on over-generation and post-hoc filtering. Inference-time steering methods like Feynman-Kac (FK) steering improve efficiency by biasing trajectories toward high-reward candidates, yet they optimize within a single fixed configuration. In de novo nanobody design, upfront commitment to conditioning choices like scaffold identity or target epitope creates a bottleneck. Since yield varies across these conditions, steering unpromising setups wastes compute. We recast generative condition selection as an inference-time resource-allocation problem. We propose two dynamic budget allocators: a joint Global Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) formulation that steers and allocates compute across configurations concurrently, and a decoupled approach adapting Batched Successive Elimination (BaSE). Empirically, these dynamic allocators increase the yield of designable candidates per GPU-hour nearly 5$\times$ without sacrificing diversity across distinct therapeutic targets and generative configurations.

items.title_en: Returning to Development States: When Full Sandbox Snapshots Help Coding Agents
items.title_zh: 返回开发状态：完整沙箱快照何时帮助编码智能体
items.abstract_en: Coding agents often make useful progress before they fail, but retry-from-scratch discards the machine state created along the way. This makes failure recovery an interesting search problem: if intermediate environment states preserve meaningful progress, restoring and branching from them could outperform repeatedly restarting from the initial state. We implement Go-Explore-style search over full Daytona snapshots and find that higher and more efficient solve rates depend mainly on progress that sits outside the repository, such as databases, services, and other runtime state. Our results suggest that full-snapshot search is most effective when long-horizon coding work spans multiple services whose state cannot be reconstructed from a single diff.

items.title_en: Specialists Learn Faster: Knowledge Organization in Pre-training Shapes Knowledge Update Efficiency
items.title_zh: 专家学习更快：预训练中的知识组织塑造知识更新效率
items.abstract_en: An ideal (language) model must continually update its knowledge. Existing work largely focuses on making these updates efficient after training. We investigate how the organization of time-varying knowledge during pre-training shapes the efficiency of subsequent updates. Models trained on chronologically ordered knowledge specialize in the most recently encountered knowledge; we call them specialists. In contrast, models trained on the same knowledge in randomly shuffled order perform well across all represented time periods; we call them generalists. Surprisingly, specialists require far fewer update steps than generalists to acquire new knowledge. To explain this advantage, we derive a law from first principles that relates update cost to the model's optimization dynamics and that closely predicts empirical results. Guided by these findings, we design a strategy for organizing pre-training data that preserves stable historical knowledge while enabling efficient updates to current knowledge. We also show that the benefits of temporal knowledge organization extend to real-world pre-trained models and existing knowledge update tools, and generalize to other knowledge orderings. Project page: https://horizon-lab.org/specialist/

items.title_en: On the Design Space of Continuous Diffusion Language Models
items.title_zh: 论连续扩散语言模型的设计空间
items.abstract_en: Continuous diffusion language models (CDLMs) promise to bring the benefits of continuous flow modelling to language, including accelerated sampling and controllable generation. The field has grown rapidly, and the capabilities of CDLMs have begun to rival those of discrete diffusion. Yet, unlike for continuous modalities such as images or videos, our grasp of the levers that matter when training CDLMs remains limited. In this work, we focus on two of these levers, namely self-conditioning and embedding geometry, and shed light on some of the mechanisms behind them, which in turn suggest cheaper and more effective designs. We begin by showing that self-conditioning corrects a train/inference mismatch by exposing the model to inference-like states that are otherwise rare during training. These gains can be recovered without an extra forward pass by a two-level interpolant, coined $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, which improves TinyGSM accuracy more than threefold. Self-conditioning also aids in recognising tokens dominated by large-norm Gaussians$\unicode{x2013}$an issue known as token identifiability. To address it directly, we introduce discrete reveals to $\mathrm{DoubleCat}$, yielding $\mathrm{SemiCat}$, which achieves discrete diffusion-level performance on TinyGSM, reaching $49.94\%$ with standard training hyperparameters and a tuned sampler. At the $1.7$B scale, $\mathrm{SemiCat}$ outperforms discrete diffusion on four of six likelihood-based evaluations, and surpasses one-hot flows on unconditional generation. On embedded spaces, we find that cross-entropy drives embeddings towards a geometry whose decoding error rate closely matches the one-hot one. We briefly explore a range of further options, such as hybrid corruption processes and noise schedules, including asynchronous ones. We believe this exploration can help the community better understand and advance the design space of CDLMs.
